The market is documented in 1596, when an order prescribed that it should last eight days and begin eight days after Michaelmas, the feast of 29 September. It had succeeded the medieval market at Kaupanger, although the exact date of the transfer is uncertain. People arriving from the coast met travellers from Valdres, Hallingdal, Sogn and northern Gudbrandsdal. The market brought these otherwise separated districts together at the head of the fjord, turning Lærdal's geographical position into a recurring commercial gathering.
simp_chinese:
莱达尔把松恩峡湾内端与越过山地、通向挪威东部的道路连接起来。在莱达尔绥里，峡湾运输与内陆道路交会，形成天然的交换场所。农民和商人在水边经营船屋与仓房，使货物得以在船只和陆路旅人之间转运。

1596年的记录规定，集市应持续八天，并于米迦勒节，即9月29日之后的第八天开始。这里接替了考庞厄尔的中世纪市场，但具体转移时间尚不确定。来自海岸的人们在此与瓦尔德雷斯、哈灵达尔、松恩及北居德布兰河谷的旅人相会。集市把这些相互隔开的地区聚到峡湾尽头，使莱达尔的地理位置转化为定期举行的商业聚会。

english: Lafia lies north of the Benue River in central Nigeria, amid the wooded savanna between the river and the Jos Plateau. The wider district was home to several communities and local rulers. Early nineteenth-century political changes in northern Nigeria brought neighbouring emirates into new relationships of authority and allegiance.
simp_chinese: 拉菲亚位于尼日利亚中部贝努埃河以北，处在河流与乔斯高原之间的林地稀树草原。更广阔的地区居住着多个社群，也有地方统治者。十九世纪初尼日利亚北部的政治变化，使相邻埃米尔国之间形成新的权力和从属关系。

english: Lafkenmapu is the land of the sea, the coastal country of the Mapuche people between the Pacific and the coastal range. Its inhabitants, the Lafkenche, drew on the resources of shore and sea as well as the lands behind them. Lafkenmapu was one of the broad territorial divisions known as butalmapus, through which communities organised alliances in times of war. Its western position also had significance in Mapuche understandings of the world.
simp_chinese: 拉夫肯马普意为“海之地”，是马普切人在太平洋与海岸山脉之间的滨海土地。当地的拉夫肯切人利用海岸、海洋及后方陆地的资源。拉夫肯马普是称为“布塔尔马普”的广大地域之一，各社群在战争时期可以此组织联盟。它所处的西方在马普切人的世界观中也有特殊意义。

english: Lafur lies in the wooded uplands of Savadkuh, south of the Caspian plain and east of Babol. Its valleys belong to the humid northern flank of the Alborz, where frequent rain sustains the old Hyrcanian forest. Beech and hornbeam grow among the trees, while streams and waterfalls descend through the slopes. Lafur was long a local centre for the surrounding mountain district.
simp_chinese: 拉富尔位于萨瓦德库赫林木繁茂的高地，在里海平原以南、巴博勒以东。这里的山谷属于厄尔布尔士山脉湿润的北坡，频繁降雨滋养着古老的希尔卡尼亚森林。山毛榉和鹅耳枥等树木生长其间，溪流与瀑布沿山坡而下。拉富尔长期是周围山区的地方中心。

english: The coast of Río Lagartos lies along northern Yucatán, where a long, shallow inlet runs behind a sandy barrier. Salt flats, mangroves and sheltered waters form a distinctive landscape on the limestone peninsula. Before the Spanish conquest, this coast belonged to Maya territories in which salt was an important resource. The waters and wetlands also support large gatherings of flamingos and other birds.
simp_chinese: 拉加托斯海岸位于尤卡坦北部，一条狭长浅水道沿沙障内侧延伸。盐滩、红树林与受庇护的水域构成石灰岩半岛上独特的景观。西班牙征服之前，这片海岸属于玛雅诸地域，盐是重要资源。水域与湿地也养育着大群火烈鸟及其他鸟类。

english:
Lages lies among the high grasslands and araucaria forests of the southern Brazilian plateau. These uplands were traditionally inhabited by Kaingang and Xokleng communities. Their open fields later became a passage for drovers moving cattle between the southern plains and São Paulo.

In 1766 Antônio Correia Pinto began a Portuguese settlement dedicated to Nossa Senhora dos Prazeres. Lages grew as a stop on the cattle route and a centre for surrounding ranches, as well as a place where erva-mate was gathered and cultivated. A road to the coast was opened at the end of the eighteenth century, strengthening its connections with Desterro on the island of Santa Catarina. In 1820 the town passed from São Paulo’s jurisdiction to that of Santa Catarina.
simp_chinese:
拉日斯位于巴西南部高原的高山草原与南洋杉森林之间。这些高地传统上是凯因甘人与肖克伦社区的居住地。后来，开阔原野成为赶牛人往来南部平原与圣保罗的通道。

1766年，安东尼奥·科雷亚·平托开始建立供奉圣母的葡萄牙聚落。拉日斯发展为牛群运输路线上的歇脚处和周围牧场的中心，人们也在此采集和种植马黛茶。十八世纪末，一条通向海岸的道路开通，加强了它与圣卡塔琳娜岛上德斯特罗的联系。1820年，该镇从圣保罗管辖转归圣卡塔琳娜。

english:
Laghouat is an oasis on the southern side of the Saharan Atlas, where palm gardens surround a fortified settlement. Ibn Khaldun described a local branch of the Maghrawa whose name became that of the town. Several small ksour once stood among the palms; as the settlement grew, the Ouled Serghin and Ouled Ahlaf occupied its principal quarters.

In 1708 a Moroccan expedition camped west of Laghouat and sought tribute from the town. The eighteenth century also brought pressure from the rulers of Algiers, whose beys intervened in the affairs of the oasis. Its inhabitants faced these outside demands amid their own divisions. By then Laghouat had become a substantial town, its gardens and walls standing at the meeting of the Atlas country and the routes leading south into the Sahara.
simp_chinese:
艾格瓦特是撒哈拉阿特拉斯山南侧的一处绿洲，棕榈园环绕着设防聚落。伊本·赫勒敦记述了当地马格拉瓦人的一个支系，其名称后来成为城镇的名字。棕榈林中曾散布着数座小城寨；随着聚落扩大，乌莱德·塞尔金和乌莱德·阿赫拉夫分别居住在主要街区。

1708年，摩洛哥远征军在艾格瓦特以西扎营，要求城镇纳贡。十八世纪，阿尔及尔统治者也向绿洲施加压力，其贝伊介入当地事务。居民在面对外部要求的同时，也有自身的分歧。到那时，艾格瓦特已是一座颇具规模的城镇，园圃和城墙立于阿特拉斯地区与南下撒哈拉的道路交会之处。

english: Lagoa Vermelha lies in the high grasslands of northeastern Rio Grande do Sul, a country crossed by routes used by livestock drovers. The lagoon from which the locality takes its name became a landmark on journeys between the southern cattle country and markets farther north. Forests along the river valleys interrupt the open plateau, and the region had Indigenous inhabitants before the arrival of Jesuit missionaries and Portuguese-speaking settlers.
simp_chinese: 拉戈阿韦梅利亚位于南里奥格兰德东北部高地草原，赶牲畜者的道路穿过此地。为当地命名的潟湖成为往来南部牧区与北方市场的旅程中的地标。河谷森林打断开阔高原，耶稣会传教士与葡萄牙语定居者到来前，地区已有原住民居住。

english: Lagonoy Gulf cuts into the eastern coast of Luzon's Bicol Peninsula. The Caramoan Peninsula and Catanduanes lie to the north, while islands including Batan and San Miguel line the southern approach. Its waters open towards the Philippine Sea and form an important fishing ground, where tuna and other fish are found among the bays and islands of the gulf.
simp_chinese: 拉戈诺伊湾凹入吕宋岛比科尔半岛东岸。卡拉莫安半岛和卡坦端内斯岛位于北侧，巴坦、圣米格尔等岛屿则分布在南侧入口。海湾向菲律宾海敞开，是重要渔场，金枪鱼等鱼类出没于海湾及岛屿之间。

sources.title: assessment of the fisheries of lagonoy gulf region 5.pdf

english: Lagonegro lies in the valley of the Noce, between Mount Sirino and the Tyrrhenian Sea. Its medieval streets cling to a rocky height around the remains of a feudal castle. Narrow, steep lanes connect the old houses and churches beneath the fortress. The church of San Nicola contains sculptures by Altobello Persio, while the valley below offers a route through the mountains towards the coast.
simp_chinese: 拉戈内格罗位于诺切河谷，介于锡里诺山与第勒尼安海之间。中世纪街巷依附岩石高地，环绕封建城堡遗迹。狭窄陡峭的小路连接堡垒下方的旧屋与教堂。圣尼古拉教堂藏有阿尔托贝洛·佩尔西奥的雕塑，山下河谷则提供穿越群山通向海岸的道路。

english: The lagoon of Bages and Sigean stretches south of Narbonne, divided into basins by islands and rocky promontories. A narrow strip of sand separates the neighbouring waters from the Mediterranean, while low shores and shallow channels shape the life of the lagoon. Fishing and salt production sustained the communities around its western banks, including Bages, Peyriac and Sigean. Vines and olives grew in the wider country beyond the water.
simp_chinese: 巴日与锡让潟湖在纳博讷以南延伸，岛屿和岩岬将水面分成数片水域。狭窄沙洲将附近水域与地中海隔开，低平的岸边和浅水通道塑造了潟湖的生活。渔业与盐业养活了西岸的巴日、佩里亚克和锡让等社区，水域之外更广阔的土地上则种植葡萄与橄榄。

english: The Étang de Berre is a broad lagoon west of Marseille, fed by the Arc, Touloubre and smaller streams. Its waters reach the Mediterranean through the passage by Martigues, where fishing communities grew beside the channel. Low shores, marshes and hills surround the lagoon, while traces of ancient and medieval settlement at Saint-Blaise recall the long history of its banks. Fresh water and the sea meet in this sheltered Provençal basin.
simp_chinese: 贝尔潟湖位于马赛以西，水域广阔，由阿尔克河、图卢布尔河及较小溪流注入。湖水经马尔蒂格附近的通道与地中海相连，渔民聚落沿通道发展。低平的湖岸、沼泽和丘陵环绕水面；圣布莱斯的古代与中世纪聚落遗迹，则让人想起湖岸悠久的历史。淡水与海水在这片受庇护的普罗旺斯水域交汇。

english: South of Comacchio, a chain of shallow brackish lagoons spreads across the low ground near the Adriatic. The waters form part of the landscape of the Po delta, close to the settlements of Comacchio, Argenta and Ravenna. Fishing has long been associated with these wetlands, especially the capture of eels; the salt pans around Comacchio also helped sustain the town's early prosperity.
simp_chinese: 科马基奥以南，一连串浅而微咸的潟湖分布在亚得里亚海附近的低地上。这片水域是波河三角洲景观的一部分，靠近科马基奥、阿真塔和拉韦纳等地。湿地长期与渔业相连，尤以捕鳗著称；科马基奥周围的盐田也曾为城镇早期的繁荣提供支撑。

english: The lagoon of Salses lies behind a narrow coastal strip between Roussillon and Languedoc. Its shallow waters supported fishing communities, whose rights and practices were recorded in medieval charters. Between the lagoon and the hills, the fortress of Salses guarded the road from Perpignan to Narbonne. French and Spanish armies fought over it in the seventeenth century before the Treaty of the Pyrenees moved the frontier south in 1659.
simp_chinese: 萨尔塞斯潟湖位于鲁西永与朗格多克之间，狭长的海岸沙洲将它与海洋隔开。浅水为渔民提供生计，中世纪的特许文书记录了当地捕鱼权利与习惯。潟湖与山丘之间，萨尔塞斯要塞守卫着佩皮尼昂通往纳博讷的道路。17世纪，法军与西班牙军反复争夺要塞，直到1659年《比利牛斯条约》将边界向南推移。

english: Lake Sanguinet lies behind the coastal dunes of the Landes. The Gourgue once flowed west to the Atlantic, but sand gradually blocked its outlet and water accumulated behind the dunes. The Gallo-Roman settlement of Losa stood beside the river before the lake rose over it. Its inhabitants abandoned Losa in the third century, and its temple was submerged by the sixth. The remains of the settlement and old wooden canoes lie beneath the lake.
simp_chinese: 桑吉内湖位于朗德海岸的沙丘之后。古尔格河曾向西流入大西洋，沙子逐渐堵塞河口，湖水便在沙丘后积聚。高卢—罗马聚落洛萨曾坐落在河边，后来水位不断上涨。居民于三世纪离开洛萨，到六世纪，聚落的神庙已被淹没。聚落遗迹和古老木舟留在湖底。

english:
Vaccarès formed a valuable body of water within the Rhône delta, with a history of ownership inseparable from control of its channels. In 1225 Hugues des Baux sold the lagoon and its associated rights to the community of Arles. The transaction included powers to open or close water passages and remove obstructions affecting the movement of water between the lagoon and the sea.

Arles retained ownership through the following centuries. This long municipal tenure ended on 25 January 1812, when the lagoon was sold at public auction in Marseille. General Alexandre Sextius Miollis acquired it and joined it to his Château d'Avignon estate. The change carried an extensive wetland from communal ownership into a private landed holding, while its waterways remained central to the practical meaning of possession.
simp_chinese:
瓦卡雷斯是罗讷河三角洲中的重要水域，其产权历史与河港控制紧密相连。1225年，于格·德·博将潟湖及其附属权利售予阿尔勒共同体。交易包括开闭水道，以及清除妨碍潟湖与海洋之间水流通行的障碍等权利。

此后数百年，阿尔勒一直持有潟湖。1812年1月25日，这段长期市有历史结束，潟湖在马赛公开拍卖。亚历山大·塞克斯蒂于斯·米奥利斯将军购得水域，将其并入自己已有的阿维尼翁堡庄园。大片湿地由市民共同体所有转为私人地产，而对水道的掌控，始终是产权在实际使用中的重要内容。

english:
Lagos in the Algarve was a port facing the routes toward the Atlantic coast of Africa. In the fifteenth century it became a departure and arrival point for Portuguese voyages along that coast. In 1444 a group of enslaved Africans was brought to Lagos and sold there, giving the town a direct place in the early development of Portuguese maritime slave trading.

The port expanded during the sixteenth century, and new walls were built around the growing town. Its maritime importance also made Lagos a centre of royal activity in the Algarve. This urban development suffered a major break in 1755, when the earthquake and the tsunami that followed destroyed much of the town. The surviving historical landscape consequently joins memories of oceanic voyages and the enslavement of Africans with fortifications and the effects of a destructive coastal disaster.
simp_chinese:
阿尔加维的拉古什是面向非洲大西洋海岸航路的港口。十五世纪，葡萄牙人沿非洲海岸航行时，这里成为船只出发与返航的据点。1444年，一批被奴役的非洲人被运抵拉古什，并在当地出售，使城镇直接参与葡萄牙早期海上奴隶贸易的发展。

十六世纪港口扩展，成长中的城镇外围修筑了新城墙。海上地位也使拉古什成为阿尔加维王室活动的中心之一。1755年，地震及随后的海啸毁坏城内大片地区，城市发展受到严重打击。因此，当地历史景观同时联系着远洋航行、非洲人的奴役、防御工事，以及破坏性海岸灾害留下的影响。

english: Lagos Lagoon lies behind the Atlantic shore, its channels linking islands and settlements with the Ijebu country. European traders used the lagoon in the sixteenth century to reach markets for cloth and enslaved people. Lagos itself grew from a fishing settlement on an island and later came under the influence of the kingdom of Benin. As Atlantic commerce expanded, its position at the meeting of lagoon and sea helped the town become an important port.
simp_chinese: 拉各斯潟湖位于大西洋海岸后方，水道将岛屿与聚落同伊杰布地区相连。十六世纪，欧洲商人沿潟湖前往购买布匹和被奴役者的市场。拉各斯本身由岛上的渔村发展而来，后来受到贝宁王国的影响。随着大西洋商业扩展，潟湖与海洋相接的位置帮助这座城镇成为重要港口。

english: Laguardia stands on a hill above the vineyards of the Rioja Alavesa. Its walls and castle protected a frontier of the kingdom of Navarre, making it a significant stronghold from the thirteenth to the fifteenth century. As its military role diminished in the sixteenth century, the town prospered through wine and the families who made their homes there. Cellars beneath its streets stored the produce of the surrounding vineyards.
simp_chinese: 拉瓜迪亚坐落在阿拉瓦里奥哈葡萄园上方的山丘上。城墙和城堡守卫着纳瓦拉王国的边境，使它在13至15世纪成为重要据点。16世纪，随着军事作用减弱，城镇凭借葡萄酒和在此定居的家族而繁荣。街道下方的地窖储藏着周边葡萄园的出产。

english: Laha lies on the eastern side of the Nen River. Its name is associated with a fish found in the river, called laha in Manchu and Daur. A road through this country carried traffic toward the Amur, and the Qing established a relay post at Laha during the Kangxi reign. The route from Jilin Ula to Aihun was completed in 1685 as the court strengthened its northeastern communications. Station households maintained the means to carry officials and urgent messages between the garrisons.
simp_chinese: 拉哈位于嫩江东侧，其名与江中一种鱼有关，满语和达斡尔语称之为拉哈。通往黑龙江的道路经过这一带，清朝康熙年间在此设驿站。为加强东北交通，吉林乌拉至瑷珲的驿路于1685年建成；站户维持传递所需的人马和车辆，运送官员及紧急公文往来驻防地之间。

english: Lahad Datu lies beside Darvel Bay on the eastern coast of northern Borneo. The Idahan people inhabit the country around the bay and the Segama River, where limestone caves hold the nests of swiftlets. For centuries Idahan families have held inherited rights to harvest these valuable nests, gathering them from caves such as Madai and Baturong. The trade connected the forests and cliffs of the interior with merchants arriving by sea.
simp_chinese: 拿笃位于婆罗洲北部东岸的达沃湾畔。伊达汉人居住在海湾与瑟加马河周围，石灰岩洞穴中有金丝燕筑巢。数百年来，伊达汉家族继承采集珍贵燕窝的权利，从马代和巴都龙等洞穴取出燕窝。这项贸易将内陆的森林与峭壁同海上到来的商人联系起来。

english: The waters off Lahad Datu open into Darvel Bay on the eastern coast of Borneo. Islands and coral reefs lie within the bay, while mangrove forests fringe parts of the shore. The bay opens towards the Celebes Sea beyond the coastal headlands. Rivers descending from the forested interior meet the sea here, contributing to a rich coastal landscape of sheltered water, islands and shallow reefs.
simp_chinese: 拿笃外海通向婆罗洲东岸的达韦尔湾。湾内分布岛屿与珊瑚礁，部分海岸生长着红树林；越过沿岸岬角，海湾通向西里伯斯海。河流从森林覆盖的内陆流向大海，在此形成由避风水域、岛屿和浅礁组成的丰富沿海景观。

english:
Lahaina lies on the sheltered western coast of Maui, looking across the channel towards Lānaʻi. Long before foreign ships arrived, it was a residence of Hawaiian chiefs and a centre of political life. Kamehameha I later made Lahaina a royal residence after bringing Maui under his authority.

The first American whaling ships arrived in 1819, and Lahaina became a port where crews took on supplies. Under Kamehameha’s successors Liholiho and Kauikeaouli, it served as a capital of the Hawaiian kingdom from 1820. By 1824 a hundred ships a year visited the port, bringing trade as well as crowds of sailors to the sheltered roadstead. Missionaries arrived in 1823, while the growing presence of sailors and merchants added new tensions to the town’s life.
simp_chinese:
拉海纳位于毛伊岛受庇护的西岸，隔海峡与拉奈岛相望。外来船只到达很久以前，它就是夏威夷首领的居所和政治中心。卡美哈美哈一世控制毛伊后，后来将拉海纳设为王室居所。

1819年，首批美国捕鲸船到来，拉海纳成为船员补充物资的港口。卡美哈美哈的继承人利霍利霍和考伊凯奥利统治时期，拉海纳自1820年起担任夏威夷王国的首都。到1824年，每年有一百艘船到访港口，为避风的锚地带来贸易和众多水手。传教士于1823年抵达，越来越多的水手与商人也给城镇生活带来新冲突。

english: Lahasusu stands near the meeting of the Songhua and Amur, where broad waterways cross the marshy Sanjiang plain. Its name is said to mean old house in the Hezhen language. Hezhen communities lived along these rivers and the Ussuri, fishing and traveling by water through the country between them. Under the Qing, officials at Sanxing administered the river peoples through local leaders, connecting this far northeastern region with the wider imperial frontier.
simp_chinese: 拉哈苏苏位于松花江与黑龙江汇合处附近，宽阔水道穿过沼泽遍布的三江平原。地名据说在赫哲语中意为“老房子”。赫哲人世居两江及乌苏里江沿岸，在水道之间捕鱼、往来。清代三姓官员通过地方首领管理沿江居民，使这片遥远东北地区与更广的帝国边疆相联系。

english: LaHave Bank is one of the submerged fishing grounds of the Scotian Shelf, off the Atlantic coast of Nova Scotia. Its waters shelter haddock, halibut and wolffish as well as cod and flatfish. Cod of the southern shelf spend the winter in deeper water around LaHave and Browns Banks, moving between the shallows and the basins that break up the shelf. Beyond the banks, the sea floor descends towards the deep Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 拉哈弗浅滩是新斯科舍大西洋海岸外斯科舍大陆架的一处水下渔场。这里栖息着黑线鳕、大比目鱼和狼鳕，也有鳕鱼及鲽类。大陆架南部的鳕鱼在拉哈弗和布朗浅滩附近的深水中越冬，往来于浅滩与陆架上的盆地之间。浅滩之外，海底逐渐向大西洋深处下降。

english: Lahe lies among the steep ridges and deep valleys of the Naga Hills, west of the upper Chindwin. Villages in these mountains have often occupied ridges and hilltops, with fields and forest spreading across the slopes below. Shifting cultivation has supplied rice and other crops, while the surrounding woodland has provided useful plants and materials. Paths through the hills link Lahe to neighbouring settlements and to the Chindwin country.
simp_chinese: 勒黑位于钦敦江上游以西的那加丘陵，四周山脊陡峭，河谷深切。山中村落常坐落在山脊和山顶，耕地与森林沿下方山坡展开。居民以轮歇耕作种植稻米和其他作物，周围林地也提供有用的植物与材料。穿山小路将勒黑与邻近聚落及钦敦江流域相连。

english: Lahei belongs to the upper Barito basin in the forested interior of Borneo. The Lahei River is a tributary of the Barito, joining the great river system that runs south towards the Java Sea. Its valley lies among a network of smaller waterways, with hills rising beyond the riverbanks. Rain and changes in river level shape the life of settlements beside the water, while the main channel connects the district with places farther downstream.
simp_chinese: 拉黑位于婆罗洲内陆森林覆盖的巴里托河上游流域。拉黑河是巴里托河的支流，汇入向南流往爪哇海的大河水系。河谷中小水道交织，河岸之外丘陵起伏。降雨与水位变化影响着沿河聚落的生活，主河道则将当地与更下游的地方连接起来。

english:
Lahijan lies east of the Safidrud in the humid lowlands of Gilan. It was the chief town of Biapish, the lands on that side of the river, and a centre of silk manufacture. Medieval accounts describe a fertile district of rice and fruit, including oranges and shaddocks. Along with Fuman to the west, Lahijan was among the principal towns of the Caspian province.

From 1367–68 the city was ruled by the Kia dynasty, whose power reached beyond Gilan in the fifteenth century. Mirza Ali Kia sheltered the young Ismail Safavi near Lahijan from 1493 to 1499, when the future shah was fleeing the Aq Qoyunlu. Ismail later founded the Safavid dynasty. Under Shah Abbas I, Gilan was brought under the Persian crown in 1592; Rasht became the provincial seat, and Lahijan's former prominence diminished.
simp_chinese:
拉希詹位于萨菲德河以东吉兰湿润的低地，是河东比亚皮什地区的首府和丝织中心。中古记述称当地土地肥沃，出产稻米以及橙子、柚子等水果。拉希詹与西面的富曼并列为这一里海地区的主要城镇。

自1367至1368年起，基亚王朝统治这座城市，十五世纪其势力一度伸展到吉兰之外。1493至1499年，未来的沙阿伊斯玛仪·萨法维为躲避白羊王朝，在拉希詹附近受到米尔扎·阿里·基亚庇护。他后来建立了萨法维王朝。1592年，沙阿阿拔斯一世将吉兰纳入波斯王室领地，拉什特成为行省驻地，拉希詹昔日的地位随之下降。

english:
Lahj is an oasis in the lowlands north of Aden, where cultivated fields and palm groves stand amid the dry country of southern Arabia. Its farmland produced grain, sesame and vegetables, and its position close to Aden tied the oasis to the port on the coast. Lahj became the seat of rulers whose authority extended from the inland settlements to the harbour.

In 1728 Fadl ibn Ali, chief of the Abdali, rejected the authority of the imam of Sanaa and declared his independence. His forces took Aden in 1735, making the port part of the Sultanate of Lahj. The new rulers faced repeated challenges: in 1753 a rebel held Lahj for several months while Aden was blockaded, and in 1771 the oasis was briefly occupied after another siege. The fortunes of the inland capital and the port remained closely connected, as the sultans defended their position among the competing powers of southern Yemen.
simp_chinese:
拉赫季是亚丁以北低地上的绿洲，耕地与棕榈林点缀着南阿拉伯的干旱地区。农田出产谷物、芝麻和蔬菜；靠近亚丁的位置又使绿洲同海岸港口紧密相连。拉赫季成为一支统治家族的治所，其权力从内陆聚落延伸至港湾。

1728年，阿卜达利部族首领法德勒·本·阿里拒绝服从萨那伊玛目，宣布独立。1735年，他的军队夺取亚丁，使港口成为拉赫季苏丹国的一部分。新的统治者多次遭遇挑战：1753年，一名叛乱者占据拉赫季数月，亚丁同时受到封锁；1771年，绿洲又在另一次围攻后短暂失陷。苏丹们在南也门诸势力的竞争中维护地位，内陆治所与港口的命运始终紧密相连。

sources.title: michael richard thomas dumper bruce stanley citbook4you.org .pdf

english:
Laholm lies on the Lagan River in southern Halland, near its passage to the Kattegat. It was among Halland's medieval towns and, under Danish rule, served as a centre for the surrounding district. Its castle was expanded in the early seventeenth century, while major fires struck the town in 1624, 1637 and 1644.

Halland passed from Denmark to Sweden provisionally in 1645 and permanently in 1658. Swedish authorities concentrated foreign trade at Halmstad and Varberg; Laholm retained its town and market privileges but lost the right to foreign trade. The settlement's changing fortunes reflected its position in a province contested by the Scandinavian kingdoms.
simp_chinese:
拉霍尔姆位于哈兰南部拉甘河畔，靠近通往卡特加特海峡的河道。它是哈兰的中世纪城镇之一，丹麦统治时期也是周边地区的行政中心。17世纪初当地城堡得到扩建，1624、1637和1644年城镇先后遭遇大火。

哈兰于1645年暂时转归瑞典，1658年正式割让。瑞典当局将对外贸易集中于哈尔姆斯塔德和瓦尔贝里；拉霍尔姆保留城镇与集市特权，却失去对外贸易权。城镇的变化反映了它位于斯堪的纳维亚王国争夺地区的处境。

english: Lahontan lies in the Minnesota and upper Mississippi country, where the Minnesota River joins the Mississippi near Bdote, the sacred meeting place of the Dakota. The bluffs and river terraces here were home to Dakota villages that farmed the flats, gathered wild rice in the lakes, and hunted bison on the prairies to the west. French traders came up the rivers in the late seventeenth century, and in 1688 the soldier and writer Louis Armand de Lom d'Arce, baron de Lahontan, described a journey up a 'Long River', an account that later readers doubted. Fort Snelling was built at the confluence in the 1820s, bringing American soldiers and fur traders into the Dakota homeland.
simp_chinese: 拉洪坦位于明尼苏达与密西西比河上游地区，明尼苏达河在神圣的聚会之地布德汇入密西西比河，那是达科他人的圣地。河畔崖地和台地上住着达科他村落，他们耕种河滩，在湖中采收野稻，并去西面草原猎取野牛。十七世纪末，法国商人溯河而来。1688年，士兵兼作家拉洪坦男爵描述了一段沿“长河”的旅行，后来的读者对这一记述颇有怀疑。1820年代，人们在两河汇流处建起斯内林堡，美国士兵和毛皮商人由此进入达科他人的家园。

english:
Lahoysk is an old town in the wooded hills north-east of Minsk. First mentioned in 1078, it became the centre of a small principality in the twelfth century before passing into the orbit of Polotsk and, later, the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. Its rulers and owners included Jogaila, Skirgaila and Vytautas, as well as the Czartoryski and Tyszkiewicz families.

In 1505 Crimean Tatars captured, plundered and burned Lahoysk. Swedish forces occupied it during the Great Northern War, when its castle was destroyed. A Basilian monastery was built in 1765, before the second partition of the Commonwealth brought the town under Russian rule in 1793. The Tyszkiewicz family subsequently built a palace here between 1814 and 1819, continuing their long association with the town and its surrounding estate.
simp_chinese:
拉霍伊斯克是明斯克东北方林木覆盖的丘陵间的一座古镇。它最早见于1078年的记载，12世纪曾是一个小公国的中心，后来先后进入波洛茨克和立陶宛大公国的势力范围。它的统治者和领主包括雅盖沃、斯基尔盖拉、维陶塔斯，以及恰尔托雷斯基和蒂什凯维奇家族。

1505年，克里米亚鞑靼人攻占、劫掠并焚毁了拉霍伊斯克。大北方战争期间，瑞典军队占领此地，城堡也遭到毁坏。1765年这里建起一座巴西利安修道院；1793年联邦第二次被瓜分后，城镇归入俄罗斯。蒂什凯维奇家族随后于1814至1819年在此修建宫邸，延续了他们与这处庄园的长期联系。

english: Lahri lies in the dry country east of Sibi, near the Kachhi plain and the routes leading towards the Indus. The surrounding land was home to Baloch and Brahui communities whose chiefs held authority over villages and grazing grounds. Seasonal streams from the hills supplied water to fields on the plain, while herders moved between lowland pastures and the uplands. The region stood between the khans of Kalat and the rulers of Sindh.
simp_chinese: 拉赫里位于锡比以东的干旱地区，靠近卡奇平原和通往印度河的道路。周围土地是俾路支和布拉灰社群的家园，首领掌管村庄与牧场。山间季节性溪流为平原田地供水，牧民则在低地牧场与高地之间移动。这一地区处于卡拉特汗与信德统治者之间。

english:
Lai Châu belonged to the mountain country along the Black River in northwestern Vietnam. Local authority and royal claims met where the Nậm Na joined that river. In 1431–1432 Lê Lợi led a campaign into this frontier against Đèo Cát Hãn, a regional lord whose resistance challenged the new Lê monarchy. Movement upriver brought the royal army into a country governed through local centres and mountain routes.

A text commemorating the campaign was carved on a cliff at the foot of Pú Huổi Chỏ beside the Black River. The inscription, remembered as the Hoài Lai stele, asserted royal authority and warned against renewed rebellion. Its position beside the water gave a durable form to a military passage through the landscape. For the surrounding country, it preserved the encounter between an upland lordship and a dynasty consolidating power after the expulsion of Ming rule. Lai Châu's history at this moment was consequently tied to a specific river corridor and a written declaration of sovereignty left upon its rocks.
simp_chinese:
莱州属于越南西北黑水河沿岸山地。南那河与黑水河汇流一带，是地方权力与王朝主张相遇之处。1431至1432年，黎利率军进入边地，讨伐抗拒新黎朝的地方领主刁吉罕。王军沿河上行，进入由地方据点和山间路线组织的地域。

纪念战事的文字刻在黑水河旁普会筹山脚的崖壁上，后称怀来碑。碑文宣示王权，警告再次反抗，将军队途经这一景观的经历化为耐久文字。对周围地区而言，它保存了明朝统治被驱逐以后，正在巩固权力的王朝与山地领主相遇的历史。此时莱州的经历因而联系着具体河道，以及留在岸边岩石上的主权宣言；河流既是军队进入山地的通路，也是王朝标示其权威的位置。

english: Lai Hka was a Shan principality on the plateau west of the Salween, where cultivated valleys lie among the wooded hills. Its hereditary rulers governed a country of small settlements and maintained relations with the Burmese kings. Under the Konbaung dynasty, the rulers of Lai Hka received the rank and insignia of saopha from the Burmese sovereign, expressing their place among the princes of the Shan highlands.
simp_chinese: 莱卡是萨尔温江以西高原上的一个掸邦政体，耕种谷地散布在林木山丘之间。世袭统治者治理着许多小聚落，并与缅甸国王保持关系。贡榜王朝时期，莱卡统治者从缅甸君主获得土司的地位和象征物，显示其在掸邦高地诸侯中的地位。

english: Lailenpi lies in the Chin Hills, a mountainous country of steep ridges and valleys west of the Irrawaddy basin. It is a settlement of the Mara people, whose communities live on both sides of the hills between the present lands of Myanmar and Mizoram. Mara villages have traditionally occupied high ground, with paths joining settlements across difficult mountain terrain. The hills provide the setting for a distinctive language and local traditions.
simp_chinese: 莱伦比位于钦山，伊洛瓦底江流域以西山脊陡峭、河谷纵横的山地中。这里是马拉人的聚落；马拉社群居住在山地两侧，分布于今缅甸与米佐拉姆之间。马拉村落传统上多建在高处，山路跨过崎岖地形连接各个聚落。这片山地孕育了当地独特的语言和传统。

sources.title: 2023 URJ Vol.14, No. 1 (Myanmar, English, Geography, History, Law, OS, Anthropology).pdf

english: Lái’ān lies east of Chúzhōu between the Huái basin and the Yangtze. Its northern country is hilly, while rivers cross the lower land to the south. The county took the name Lái’ān under the Southern Táng. During the Míng, the Zhāng family and their neighbours reclaimed low-lying land with embankments, building villages beside the fields they protected.
simp_chinese: 来安位于滁州以东、江淮之间。北部多丘陵，南部低地河流纵横。南唐时期县名定为来安。明代，章氏与乡邻筑圩围垦低地，并在受到堤防保护的田地旁建立村落。

english: Sìchéng, in the hills of western Guangxi, was ruled by hereditary chiefs of the Cen family. In 1372 the Ming commander Zhou Dexing took the district, and Cen Shanzhong submitted and received the hereditary office of prefect. In 1681 the chief Cen Jilu built a school for his family at Sicheng; it later became a Confucian temple.
simp_chinese: 广西西部山区的泗城由岑氏土司世袭统治。1372年，明将周德兴攻取泗城，岑善忠归附并受封世袭知州。1681年，土司岑继禄在泗城兴建家族学堂，后来改为文庙。

english: Laibin lies beside the Liu River in central Guangxi. The county received its name in 743, when the Tang renamed the earlier county of Huaiyi. In 1261 officials built a town on Penglai Island in the river, within Laibin's territory, and moved the seat of Xiangzhou there the following year. The prefectural seat later moved again, but the river remained a prominent feature of the country around Laibin and its county town.
simp_chinese: 来宾位于广西中部柳江之畔。743年，唐朝将原来的怀义县改名来宾，县名由此而来。1261年，官府在来宾境内的江中蓬莱洲筑州城，次年将象州州治迁至岛上。州治后来再次迁移，柳江仍是来宾县城及周围地区的重要地理标志。

english:
L'Aigle grew around a fortified castle in the Pays d'Ouche, on the River Risle. Its walls could not save it from the Hundred Years' War: English forces took the town and demolished the fortress. In the years after the war, forges and small metalworking trades helped the town recover.

Pin-making became a particular speciality of L'Aigle and its neighbourhood. The industry used iron from local forges as well as supplies brought from farther afield. By the eighteenth century thousands of people worked for the pin industry in the town and surrounding country. On the site of the old fortress, the marquis Louis des Acres began a new château in 1690. Work continued under his successors and was completed some forty years later.
simp_chinese:
莱格勒围绕乌什地区里勒河畔的一座设防城堡发展起来。百年战争中，城墙没能保住城镇：英军占领此地并拆毁了堡垒。战后，锻铁炉和小型金属工艺帮助城镇恢复生机。

制针成为莱格勒及周边地区的特长，所用铁料既来自当地锻炉，也由远方运入。到十八世纪，城镇和乡村已有数千人为制针业工作。1690年，路易·德扎克尔侯爵在旧堡垒的遗址上开始建造一座新城堡。工程由他的继承人继续推进，约四十年后才告完成。

sources.title: L Aigle Délimitation des abords des Monuments Historiques 2307.pdf

english:
Lail buil lies in the broad river country associated with the Wemba-Wemba people of southeastern Australia. Their country extended around the Loddon and Avoca rivers, north towards Swan Hill and across the Murray into what is now New South Wales. Lake Boga was among the places within this wider territory. Rivers, wetlands and woodlands formed a varied landscape, with water and other resources changing through the seasons.

Wemba-Wemba communities spoke their own language and maintained connections to particular places within this country. Their religious and cultural understanding included a Dreaming known as yemurraki. European exploration reached Wemba-Wemba territory in 1836, when Thomas Mitchell crossed the area. The region's Indigenous history, however, stretches far beyond that encounter and is rooted in enduring relationships between people, water and country.
simp_chinese:
莱尔布伊尔位于澳大利亚东南部与温巴温巴人相关的广阔河流地域。温巴温巴人的土地环绕洛登河和阿沃卡河，向北延伸至斯旺希尔一带，并越过墨累河进入今日的新南威尔士州；博加湖也在其范围之内。河流、湿地与林地构成多样的景观，水源和其他资源随季节而变化。

温巴温巴社群使用自己的语言，并与这片土地上的不同地点保持联系。他们的宗教和文化观念包括称为 yemurraki 的梦创传统。1836年，欧洲探险者托马斯·米切尔穿过温巴温巴人的地域。但当地原住民的历史远不止这次相遇，更植根于人与土地、水域之间长久的联系。

english:
Layla is a settlement of the al-Aflaj oasis country in southern Najd. Its old town contains closely spaced earthen houses, narrow lanes, mosques, towers and fortified residences. Courtyard houses opened inward, providing shade and privacy. The settlement developed on the site of an older village called an-Naqiyyah.

The name Layla is associated in local tradition with Layla al-Amiriyyah, beloved of the poet Qays ibn al-Mulawwah. Their story belongs to the country of al-Aflaj: near al-Ghayl stands Mount al-Tawbad, whose cave is linked to the lovers. The inhabitants of Layla also held palm groves at al-Sayh, where families gathered during the summer date harvest in the surrounding country. The oases and their channels formed a connected landscape of farms and settlements across the plain.
simp_chinese:
莱拉是内志南部艾弗拉季绿洲地区的一处聚落。旧城中土筑房屋紧密相连，窄巷穿行其间，还有清真寺、塔楼和设防宅院。住宅向内围合庭院，既可遮荫，也保护家庭私生活。聚落在旧村纳基耶的遗址上发展起来。

地方传统将莱拉之名与诗人盖斯·伊本·穆拉瓦赫的爱人莱拉·阿米里耶联系在一起。他们的故事属于艾弗拉季地区：盖勒附近的陶巴德山有一处洞穴，相传与这对恋人有关。莱拉居民也在赛赫拥有枣椰园，周边地区夏季椰枣成熟时，家族会在那里聚集。绿洲及其渠道将平原上的农庄和聚落连成一片。

english: Lairmairrener country belongs to the central river and highland regions of lutruwita, or Tasmania. The Big River people occupied a landscape of rivers, forests and open land, with connections to neighbouring peoples of the eastern coast. British colonisation from 1803 brought increasing pressure on Aboriginal lands, followed by violent conflict and the removal of many survivors during the 1830s.
simp_chinese: 莱迈伦纳地区位于卢特鲁维塔即塔斯马尼亚中部的河流与高地。大河人生活在河流、森林和开阔土地之间，并与东岸邻居保持联系。1803年开始的英国殖民使原住民土地承受越来越大压力，随后爆发暴力冲突，许多幸存者在1830年代被迁离。

sources.title: Visitor Information Welcome to Oatlands Brochure Updated Jun2022.pdf

english:
Laish belongs to the Volga-Kama country around Kazan, where major waterways have long connected forests, agricultural districts, and the Eurasian steppe. River transport enabled the circulation of grain, fish, timber, and manufactured goods. Communities along this corridor combined cultivation with activities suited to woodland and water, while market settlements brought together people from different linguistic and religious backgrounds. The meeting of the Volga and Kama systems gave the wider region considerable commercial importance.

The wider region's political history included Volga Bulgaria, the Golden Horde, and the Kazan Khanate, whose institutions linked society with broader Islamic and steppe traditions. Russian conquest transformed the balance of power and brought new systems of administration and settlement. Tatar communities and other regional peoples continued to live there, sustaining religious institutions, village relationships, and commercial networks through changes of rule.
simp_chinese:
莱什属于喀山周边的伏尔加—卡马地区，大河长期连接森林、农业区与欧亚草原。水运使粮食、鱼类、木材和手工业品流通，沿岸社群将耕作同适合林地及水域的活动结合起来。市场聚落汇集不同语言和宗教背景的人群，伏尔加河与卡马河水系交会的位置，使整个地区具有重要商业价值。

更广阔地区先后经历伏尔加保加尔、金帐汗国和喀山汗国的统治，其制度将社会同伊斯兰及草原传统联系起来。俄国征服改变了力量平衡，带来新的行政和定居体系，但鞑靼社群及其他地区民族仍持续生活于此。宗教机构、村落关系与商业网络在统治者更替期间继续维系社会生活。

english: Laishui lies where the northern mountains meet the Hebei plain. On the southern slope of Longgong Mountain, the pagoda of Qinghua Temple rises from a cliff platform. Its brickwork is richly ornamented: musicians and dancers adorn the base, while tiers of small Buddhist niches climb toward the summit. Its style belongs to the Liao period. Another local pagoda at Longyan Temple was repaired in 1506 and 1595 under the Ming.
simp_chinese: 涞水位于北方群山与河北平原的交界。龙宫山南坡崖台上矗立着庆化寺花塔，砖雕基座饰有乐伎与舞者，上部层层排列小佛龛，风格属于辽代。当地另一座龙严寺塔在明代1506年和1595年得到修葺。

english: Laiwu was a major ironworking district in the hills east of Mount Tai. Mines and furnaces supported settlements such as Shimenye, whose smelting works became large enough for the place to be known as the Iron Smelting City. Under the Yuan, officials at Laiwu supervised mines and smelters across much of Shandong. The early Ming continued to value its production, establishing one of thirteen government ironworks here in 1373; the Daye smelting site remained in use into the Xuande reign.
simp_chinese: 莱芜是泰山东侧丘陵地带的重要冶铁区。矿山和炉场附近形成聚落，石门冶规模宏大，曾有“铁冶城”之称。元代莱芜的官署管理山东广大地区的矿冶事务。明初仍重视这里的产铁，于1373年在莱芜设官办铁冶所；大冶冶炼场一直使用至宣德年间。

english: Laiyang lies among the hills and river valleys of eastern Shandong. Streams from the surrounding country meet south of the county town to form the Wulong River. The place was once called Changyang and acquired the name Laiyang under the Later Tang. During the Ming the town was divided into six wards, while the surrounding countryside was organised into fourteen townships. In 1630, amid the troubles of the late dynasty, Dong Dacheng led thousands of rebels in an attack on the county seat.
simp_chinese: 莱阳位于山东东部丘陵与河谷之间，周围溪流在县城以南汇合成五龙河。此地旧称昌阳，后唐时改名莱阳。明代县城分为六坊，乡间分十四乡。明末动乱中，董大成于1630年率数千起事者围攻县城，给地方带来了战事。

english: Laizhou Bay forms the southern arm of the Bohai Sea, its shallow waters bordered by the northern Shandong coast. River-borne silt has built broad low shores, and for centuries people extracted brine and boiled salt along the southern side of the bay. Under the Yuan, an attempt was made to link the bay with Jiaozhou Bay by canal, allowing grain ships to cross the peninsula rather than round the exposed eastern headlands. The waterway was used intermittently in later years.
simp_chinese: 莱州湾是渤海南部伸入山东北岸的一片浅海。河流带来的泥沙在岸边堆积成广阔低地，湾南居民长期汲取卤水、煎煮食盐。元代曾尝试开凿胶莱运河，将莱州湾与胶州湾相连，使运粮船穿越半岛，避开东端风浪较大的海角；运河后来时通时废。

english:
Lakam Tun was a Lakandon Ch’ol settlement on an island in Lake Miramar, surrounded by the forests of eastern Chiapas. The lake and its island formed a defensible centre in a region of rivers and dense vegetation. Its name was also applied by the Spanish to the people and the forest region they inhabited, although the name covered several related communities.

Spanish forces took Lakam Tun in 1586. Its inhabitants withdrew deeper into the forest, where they established another centre, Sak Balam, and resisted colonial rule for more than a century. In 1695 a further Spanish campaign reached Sak Balam. The long resistance of the Lakandon Ch’ol made the forest one of the last parts of Chiapas to come under Spanish control.
simp_chinese:
拉卡姆通是米拉马尔湖一座岛上的拉坎东乔尔人聚落，四周环绕恰帕斯东部森林。湖泊与岛屿在河流和茂密植被交织的地区构成易守的中心。西班牙人也用这一名称指称当地居民及其居住的森林地区，名称涵盖数个彼此相关的社群。

西班牙军队于1586年攻占拉卡姆通。居民退入丛林深处，另建萨克巴拉姆，并抵抗殖民统治一个多世纪。1695年，另一支西班牙远征队抵达萨克巴拉姆。拉坎东乔尔人的长期抵抗，使这片森林成为恰帕斯最后落入西班牙控制的地区之一。

english:
Lake Abitibi is a broad, shallow lake amid the forests of the interior. Its waters drain north through the Abitibi and Moose rivers to James Bay, while portages connect its basin with the Ottawa River watershed to the south. The lake lies within the homeland of Anishinaabe peoples and became an important meeting place in the fur trade.

In 1686 Pierre de Troyes passed through the lake on an expedition against English posts on James Bay and established a French post there. Traders approaching from the south and from the bay sought relationships with Indigenous communities, whose routes and knowledge made commerce across the region possible. The lake remained a centre of the inland fur trade for generations after the expedition.
simp_chinese:
阿比蒂比湖位于内陆森林之中，湖面宽阔而水浅。湖水向北经阿比蒂比河和穆斯河注入詹姆斯湾，搬舟路线则将其流域与南方的渥太华河水系相连。这座湖位于阿尼希纳贝人的故土，后来成为毛皮贸易的重要会合地。

1686年，皮埃尔·德·特鲁瓦率远征队途经此湖，前往袭击詹姆斯湾的英国商站，并在湖边建立法国据点。来自南方和海湾的商人都寻求与原住民社区建立关系；当地人的路线与知识使跨地区贸易得以开展。远征之后，这座湖在数代人间一直是内陆毛皮贸易的中心。

english: Lake Achinos spread across the lower Strymon valley north of Amphipolis, a shallow expanse fed by the river before it reached the Aegean. Known in antiquity as Lake Cercinitis, it formed part of a waterway linking the Strymonic Gulf with the interior. Its waters and those of the river were rich in fish; the Strymon's eels were particularly celebrated in ancient accounts. The lake expanded and contracted with the changing flow of the river and the seasons.
simp_chinese: 阿基诺斯湖铺展在安菲波利斯以北的斯特鲁马河下游河谷中。河流注入这片浅水湖泊，再流向爱琴海。古代的凯尔基尼蒂斯湖便是这里，它构成连接斯特里蒙湾与内陆的水路一部分。湖泊和河流中鱼类丰富，斯特鲁马河的鳗鱼尤其受到古人称赞。湖面的范围随着河流流量和季节变化而扩大或缩小。

english: Achit Lake lies in a high basin of the Mongolian Altai, surrounded by mountains and steppe. It is a shallow freshwater lake, fed by streams descending from the ranges and connected by a channel to the Khovd River system. Wetlands around its shores provide nesting and feeding grounds for waterbirds. Pastoral households use the surrounding country for seasonal grazing, while the lake and marshes form a conspicuous expanse of water in the dry uplands.
simp_chinese: 阿奇特湖位于蒙古阿尔泰山高地盆地中，四周环绕山脉和草原。它是一座浅淡水湖，由山间溪流补给，并通过水道与科布多河水系相连。湖岸湿地为水鸟提供筑巢和觅食之地，牧民则利用周围土地进行季节性放牧。湖泊与沼泽在干燥高地中形成醒目的水域。

english: Acıgöl lies between Denizli and Dinar in western Anatolia, in a basin enclosed by mountains. The lake's Turkish name means “bitter lake”, reflecting its saline water. Flamingos and ducks gather on the lake, while cranes nest near the springs around its shores. As the water recedes, the shallow basin reveals pale, mineral-rich ground.
simp_chinese: 阿哲湖位于安纳托利亚西部的代尼兹利与迪纳尔之间，群山环抱着湖盆。湖名在土耳其语中意为“苦湖”，反映其水中盐分。火烈鸟和鸭子在湖上聚集，鹤则在湖岸周围的泉水旁筑巢。水位下降时，浅湖盆中露出颜色浅淡、富含矿物的土地。

english: Agh Gol, the “White Lake,” lies below sea level on the Mil plain of the Kura-Aras lowlands. Formed by the flooding of the great rivers, its waters and marshes stand amid a landscape of dry steppe and semi-desert. Reeds and shallow water provide shelter for fish and waterbirds, including herons, ibises, ducks and geese. Migrating birds rest or winter here, making the lake a conspicuous refuge of water and life in the surrounding plain.
simp_chinese: 阿格湖意为“白湖”，位于库拉—阿拉斯低地的米尔平原，湖面低于海平面。大河泛滥形成了这片湖泊与沼泽，四周则是干燥草原和半荒漠。芦苇与浅水为鱼类和水鸟提供栖身之地，其中有鹭、鹮、鸭和雁。候鸟在这里歇息或越冬，使湖泊成为周围平原上醒目的水域与生灵庇护所。

english: Airag Lake lies in western Mongolia's Great Lakes Depression, connected to the larger Khyargas Lake by a short channel. Its fresh water contrasts with the salt water of its northern neighbour. The two lakes once occupied the same basin, and Airag still receives water from the network of rivers and lakes to the south. Its shallow waters warm through much of their depth in summer.
simp_chinese: 艾拉格湖位于蒙古西部大湖盆地，一条短水道将它与较大的哈尔嘎斯湖连接起来。艾拉格湖是淡水湖，与北面的咸水邻湖形成鲜明对照。两湖曾处于同一个盆地，艾拉格湖至今仍接纳南方河流与湖群的来水。夏季阳光能使浅湖的水温升高，直达近湖底处。

english: Lake Akşehir lies in a closed basin north of the Sultan Mountains. Streams and water from neighbouring Lake Eber collect in its shallow basin, whose shores support reeds and marshes. Herons, ibises and other birds nest among the reed beds and sandy islets. The town of Akşehir stands south of the water, where the foothills meet the cultivated plain along an old road across Anatolia.
simp_chinese: 阿克谢希尔湖位于苏丹山脉以北的封闭盆地。溪流与邻近埃贝尔湖的来水汇入浅湖，岸边生长芦苇并形成沼泽。苍鹭、朱鹭等鸟类在芦苇丛和沙洲间筑巢。阿克谢希尔城位于湖水以南，山麓与耕作平原相接，古道横贯安纳托利亚经过这里。

english: Long and narrow Lake Albanel lies just east of the much larger Lake Mistassini, in the lake country draining towards James Bay. Its waters receive the Témiscamie River before passing into Mistassini. The Cree name Mistasiniish distinguishes the lake from its larger neighbour. The French name recalls Charles Albanel, a Jesuit who travelled by way of the Saguenay and Lake Mistassini to James Bay in 1672, on a journey made possible by Indigenous guides and companions.
simp_chinese: 狭长的阿尔巴内尔湖位于米斯塔西尼湖以东，属于流向詹姆斯湾的湖泊水系。泰米斯卡米河注入此湖，湖水再流入米斯塔西尼湖。克里语名称 Mistasiniish 将它与更大的邻湖区分开来。湖泊的法语名称纪念耶稣会士夏尔·阿尔巴内尔；1672年，他在原住民向导和同行者的帮助下，经萨格奈和米斯塔西尼湖抵达詹姆斯湾。

english: Lake Albert fills a long depression in the western branch of the East African Rift, beneath steep escarpments. The Semliki River enters its southern end after draining Lake Edward, while the Victoria Nile reaches its northern end after plunging over the Murchison Falls. The lake's waters continue north as the Albert Nile. On the eastern shore, hot springs feed saline deposits that have long supplied the salt workers of Kibiro.
simp_chinese: 艾伯特湖填满东非大裂谷西支的一处狭长洼地，两岸陡崖高耸。塞姆利基河将爱德华湖的水带入湖泊南端；维多利亚尼罗河则在跌落默奇森瀑布后，从北端注入。湖水继续向北流出，成为艾伯特尼罗河。东岸温泉形成的含盐沉积物，长期为基比罗的制盐者提供原料。

english: Lake Amik spread across the low plain northeast of Antioch, its fresh water fringed by extensive marshes. The Afrin and Kara Su fed the basin from the north, and its waters drained towards the Orontes. Fishermen caught eels and other fish among the reeds, while water buffalo grazed in the wetlands. Roads from Antioch to Aleppo and Marash skirted the lake and marsh, crossing the broad alluvial plain between the Amanus and Kurdish mountains.
simp_chinese: 阿米克湖铺展在安条克东北的低平原上，淡水湖周围是广阔沼泽。阿夫林河和卡拉苏河从北方汇入，湖水流向奥龙特河。渔民在芦苇间捕捉鳗鱼等鱼类，水牛在湿地放牧。安条克通往阿勒颇和马拉什的道路绕过湖泊与沼泽，穿越阿马努斯山和库尔德山之间宽广的冲积平原。

english: Aqqikkol, the “bitter lake”, lies in the western Kumkol Basin beneath the Kunlun Mountains. Streams flow into this high saline lake, which has no outlet to the sea. Its shores are set in a cold, dry plateau of mountains and open ground. Wild yak, Tibetan wild ass and antelope inhabit the wider region, moving across the sparse pastures and wetlands around its scattered lakes.
simp_chinese: 阿其克库勒意为“苦湖”，位于昆仑山下库木库里盆地西部。溪流注入这座高原咸水湖，湖水没有通往海洋的出口。湖岸坐落在寒冷干燥的高原上，周围是山岭和开阔土地。野牦牛、藏野驴和藏羚羊生活在这一带，在湖泊附近稀疏的草地与湿地间活动。

english:
Lake Athabasca stretches eastward from the great delta of the Peace and Athabasca rivers. Rocky shores and islands lie to the north, while sand dunes rise along part of the southern shore. Its waters flow west through the Slave River towards Great Slave Lake. The lake and its surrounding country were home to Dene peoples, known to the fur traders as Chipewyan, whose hunting and travel routes extended far beyond its shores.

In 1778 Peter Pond crossed the Methye Portage and wintered on the Athabasca River, where he met Cree and Chipewyan traders. A decade later Roderick Mackenzie built Fort Chipewyan at Old Fort Point on the lake's southern shore. The post became a centre of the Athabasca fur trade, drawing on the rich hunting grounds to the north and east. In the 1790s it was moved to the northern shore, where the ice broke up earlier and the spring brigades could begin their long journey sooner.
simp_chinese:
阿萨巴斯卡湖从和平河与阿萨巴斯卡河汇成的广阔三角洲向东延伸。北岸岩石嶙峋、岛屿众多，南岸部分地段则耸立着沙丘。湖水向西流入斯莱夫河，前往大奴湖。湖泊及周边地区是德内人的家园；毛皮商人称他们为奇佩维安人，他们的狩猎和旅行路线远远超出湖岸。

1778年，彼得·庞德越过梅西转运道，在阿萨巴斯卡河畔过冬，并遇到克里和奇佩维安商人。十年后，罗德里克·麦肯齐在湖南岸的老堡角建起奇佩维安堡。商站利用东北方丰饶的狩猎区，成为阿萨巴斯卡毛皮贸易的中心。1790年代，商站迁往北岸；那里春季冰封消融较早，使运货队能够更早踏上漫长的旅程。

english: Ayakkum is a great saline lake in the northern Kumkol Basin, between the Altun and Kunlun mountains. Intermittent rivers and streams fed by snow and glaciers flow into its enclosed basin; their waters leave no passage to the sea. Deltas spread along the shore where mountain streams enter the lake. Its open water, surrounded by high, arid country, is one of the striking features of the northern Tibetan Plateau.
simp_chinese: 阿雅克库木湖是库木库里盆地北部的大型咸水湖，位于阿尔金山与昆仑山之间。季节性河流及冰雪融水汇入封闭盆地，湖水没有通往海洋的出口。山间溪流入湖处形成三角洲；开阔水面四周环绕干旱高地，是青藏高原北缘鲜明的景观之一。

english:
Lake Bafa occupies the former Gulf of Latmos on the western Anatolian coast. Sediment from the Maeander gradually separated this inlet from the Aegean, changing the relationship between the old harbour country and the sea. Above its eastern shore rise the Latmos mountains, where caves, rocky slopes and islands became settings for Byzantine religious life. Monasteries and hermitages reused a landscape already rich in ancient settlements and sacred associations.

Many surviving Christian sanctuaries date from the twelfth and thirteenth centuries, and religious establishments remained active into the early fourteenth century. Kahve Asar island preserves a fortified monastery of the thirteenth century; other foundations occupied the mainland slopes and islands within the lake. The advance of the Menteşe principality ended Byzantine political control of the region. Walls, churches and painted caves remained as traces of the monastic landscape beside a body of water whose gradual separation from the sea had already transformed access to the surrounding settlements.
simp_chinese:
巴法湖占据安纳托利亚西海岸昔日的拉特莫斯湾。迈安德河不断带来的泥沙逐渐将海湾与爱琴海分开，改变了古老港区同外海的联系。湖东岸的拉特莫斯山中，洞窟、岩坡与湖上岛屿成为拜占庭宗教生活的场所。修道院和隐修处利用着这片早已有古代聚落与神圣传说的景观。

现存许多基督教圣所建于十二至十三世纪，宗教机构一直活跃到十四世纪初。卡赫韦阿萨尔岛保存着十三世纪设防修道院的遗迹，其他修道设施则分布于湖中岛屿和陆地山坡。门泰谢侯国的推进结束了拜占庭在当地的政治统治。城墙、教堂与绘有壁画的洞窟留下修道生活的痕迹；在这些政治变化之前，海湾逐渐变成湖泊的过程，已经重塑了沿岸聚落通往海洋的道路。

english: Lake Balaton stretches across western Hungary beneath the hills of Transdanubia. Its broad, shallow waters are fed by the Zala and drain eastward through the Sió. The Tihany peninsula projects into the lake from the northern shore, narrowing the water between its two halves. King Andrew I founded a Benedictine abbey on the peninsula in 1055 and was buried there. During the Ottoman wars the abbey was fortified, becoming a stronghold above the lake and the roads along its shore.
simp_chinese: 巴拉顿湖横贯匈牙利西部，位于多瑙河西岸的丘陵之下。宽阔而浅的湖水由佐洛河等水流注入，向东经希奥河排出。蒂豪尼半岛从北岸伸入湖中，使湖面在此收窄。1055年，安德烈一世国王在半岛上建立本笃会修院，并葬于此。奥斯曼战争期间，修院被加固为要塞，俯瞰湖面与沿岸道路。

english: Lake Bangweulu lies in a shallow basin surrounded by an immense expanse of marsh, grassland and seasonal floodplain. Its name is often understood as “where the water meets the sky.” The Chambeshi and other rivers feed the wetland system; the Luapula carries its waters away towards Lake Mweru and ultimately the Congo. Islands and channels punctuate a landscape transformed by the annual rise and fall of the waters.
simp_chinese: 班韦乌卢湖坐落在浅盆地中，周围是广阔的沼泽、草地和季节性泛滥平原。湖名常被解释为“水天相接之处”。谦比希河等河流为湿地供水，卢阿普拉河则将水送往姆韦鲁湖，最终流入刚果河。岛屿和水道散布其间，水位每年的涨落不断改变着这片景观。

english: Lake Bardawil is a shallow saline lagoon on the northern coast of Sinai, separated from the Mediterranean by a long sandbar. Its waters and marshes form a habitat for fish and birds along the arid coast. The name recalls Baldwin, the crusader king of Jerusalem who died near the lagoon in 1118 while returning from an expedition into Egypt.
simp_chinese: 巴达维勒湖是西奈半岛北岸的一座浅咸水潟湖，由长长的沙洲与地中海隔开。湖水和湿地在干旱海岸上为鱼类与鸟类提供栖息地。湖名让人想起耶路撒冷十字军国王鲍德温：1118年，他从远征埃及的途中返回时死于湖泊附近。

english: Lake Bakhtegan occupies a broad inland basin east of Shiraz. Its shallow, saline waters receive the Kur River at the western end, while the Sahlabad spring enters from the south. Rain and mountain snow cause the lake to expand and retreat; in wet years it may join neighbouring Lake Tashk. Flamingos and other waterbirds gather around the lake, its islands and the marshes of the lower Kur.
simp_chinese: 巴赫特甘湖位于设拉子以东宽阔的内陆盆地中，湖水浅而咸。库尔河从西端注入，南岸还有萨赫拉巴德泉补给。雨水与山地融雪使湖面时涨时落，丰水年份甚至会与邻近的塔什克湖连成一片。火烈鸟和其他水鸟聚集在湖泊、湖中岛屿及库尔河下游的沼泽地带。

english: Laguna de Bay is a broad, shallow lake southeast of Manila, named for the old Tagalog settlement of Bay on its southern shore. Its many arms receive rivers from the surrounding hills, and the Pasig River links its waters to Manila Bay. Lakeside communities travelled and traded by water, carrying produce between the settlements around its shores. The lake's size and position made it a natural meeting place between the inland valleys and the coast.
simp_chinese: 拉古纳德巴伊是马尼拉东南方宽阔而浅的大湖，因南岸古老的他加禄聚落巴伊得名。湖泊伸出多个湖湾，接纳周围丘陵的河流，帕西格河则将湖水与马尼拉湾相连。湖滨社群乘船往来贸易，在沿岸聚落之间运送物产。湖泊的规模和位置使它成为内陆河谷与海岸之间天然的会合之处。

english: Bayan Lake lies west of the Tarvagatai Mountains, on the edge of the sand dunes of western Mongolia. Its name means “rich lake” in Mongolian. Along with Ulaagchiin Khar Lake farther east, it forms a freshwater refuge amid a landscape where desert sands meet mountain and steppe. The contrast between the open water and the long ridges of the Bor Khyar dunes gives this basin a distinctive appearance.
simp_chinese: 巴彦湖位于塔尔巴嘎台山以西、蒙古西部沙丘的边缘，其蒙古语名称意为“富饶的湖”。它与更东面的乌拉格钦黑湖共同构成一片淡水水域，周围是荒漠沙地、山地和草原交汇的景观。开阔湖水与博尔希亚尔沙丘的长长沙脊相映，使这座盆地别具面貌。

english: White Lake spreads across the northern Volga basin, receiving the Kovzha and giving rise to the Sheksna. Its open waters formed a link in the route between the Volga and the northern lakes, with portages beyond the Kovzha leading towards Lake Onega. Fishing was valuable to communities and monasteries around the lake. In the fifteenth century the Trinity monastery received privileges to send boats to White Lake for fish and trade.
simp_chinese: 白湖横亘于伏尔加河流域北部，接纳科夫扎河，又流出舍克斯纳河。湖面是伏尔加河与北方湖泊之间航路的一环；越过科夫扎河的陆上转运道可通往奥涅加湖。捕鱼对湖边社群和修道院十分重要。十五世纪，圣三一修道院获得特权，派船到白湖捕鱼和贸易。

english: Lake Beyşehir fills a broad basin between the mountains of southwestern Anatolia and the Konya plain. Its fresh waters contain many islands, while reeds and wetlands fringe the shore. Fish inhabit the lake, and its islands provide nesting places for cormorants, herons and other water birds. The town of Beyşehir stands near its southeastern end, where the water meets cultivated land and routes through the mountains.
simp_chinese: 贝伊谢希尔湖充满安纳托利亚西南山地与科尼亚平原之间的宽阔盆地。淡水中散布许多岛屿，湖岸生长芦苇并形成湿地。湖中有鱼，岛屿为鸬鹚、苍鹭等水鸟提供筑巢之地。贝伊谢希尔城位于湖的东南端附近，水域在此与耕地及穿山道路相接。

english: Lake Bienville is a great expanse of water in the interior of the Labrador Peninsula, scattered with islands along its shores. It is the principal source of the Great Whale River, which flows west to Hudson Bay; other outlets connect the lake with neighbouring watersheds. Among its Cree names is Abchigamiche, recorded as meaning “lake where there is little water.” The French name honours Jean-Baptiste Le Moyne de Bienville, who took part in the French attacks on English posts around Hudson Bay in 1697 and 1698.
simp_chinese: 比安维尔湖是拉布拉多半岛内陆的一片广阔水域，沿岸散布着无数岛屿。它是大鲸河的主要源头，河水向西流入哈得孙湾；湖泊的其他出口也与邻近流域相连。湖的克里语名称之一阿布希加米什，据记载意为“水少的湖”。法语名称纪念让-巴蒂斯特·勒穆瓦纳·德·比安维尔；1697至1698年间，他参与了法国对哈得孙湾周围英国据点的进攻。

english:
Lake Biwa fills the basin of Omi in central Japan. Its waters drain south through the Seta River toward Kyoto and the Yodo system, while roads along both shores connect the Japan Sea provinces with the capital. Fishing, reed gathering and cultivation supported lakeside settlement; boats carried rice, timber, salt and other bulky goods more cheaply than carts, giving the lake a place in the provisioning of Kyoto.

Buddhist foundations and warrior houses competed for its ports and revenues. In 1576 Oda Nobunaga began Azuchi Castle on the eastern shore, using the lake route and Omi's roads to control movement toward Kyoto. After his fall Toyotomi Hideyoshi reorganised the crossing and in 1587 established the Otsu hundred-boat group to regulate shipping. Castle towns and post stations grew where land routes met the water.

Under the Tokugawa shogunate, Lake Biwa remained a commercial artery. Rice from northern provinces, fish from lakeside villages and goods bound for Osaka moved through Otsu and Hikone. Omi merchants extended family trading networks across Japan, joining local fisheries and farms to national politics, religion and commerce.
simp_chinese:
琵琶湖位于日本中部的近江盆地。湖水经南端濑田川流向京都和淀川水系，沿岸道路则把日本海沿岸诸国同都城连接起来。捕鱼、采集芦苇和耕作支撑湖岸聚落，舟船以低于车运的成本运送稻米、木材、盐等大宗货物，使琵琶湖参与京都的物资供应。

佛教寺院与武士家族争夺湖畔港口和收益。1576年，织田信长在东岸开始营建安土城，借助湖上航路和近江道路控制通往京都的交通。信长死后，丰臣秀吉重整水路，并在1587年设立大津百艘船以组织湖上运输。陆路与水路交会之处逐渐形成城下町和宿场。

德川幕府时期，琵琶湖仍是重要商业动脉。北国稻米、湖畔鱼类和运往大阪的货物经过大津、彦根等港口。近江商人把家族贸易网络扩展至全国各地，使地方渔业和农业同全国政治、宗教及商业相连。

english: Lake Bolon lies on the western floodplain of the Amur, connected to the great river by a channel. The Simmi and Kharpi flow into the lake through a maze of smaller lakes, marshes and old river bends. Its shallows provide spawning and feeding grounds for fish, while the surrounding wetlands shelter great flocks of migrating waterbirds. Geese, swans and cranes stop here on journeys along the Amur valley.
simp_chinese: 博隆湖位于黑龙江西岸的泛滥平原，通过水道与大江相连。西米河和哈尔皮河流经小湖、沼泽及旧河曲组成的水网，注入湖中。浅水为鱼类提供产卵和觅食之地，周围湿地则庇护大群迁徙水鸟。雁、天鹅和鹤沿黑龙江谷地迁飞时，在这里停歇。

english: Lake Bolsena fills a great volcanic depression in the hills of Tuscia. The Romans called it Lacus Volsinii, after an ancient Etruscan city. Two islands rise from its southern waters, formed by eruptions beneath the lake after the depression itself had taken shape. Rain, runoff and underground water feed the lake, which drains southward through the River Marta. The ancient Via Cassia ran beside its shores.
simp_chinese: 博尔塞纳湖占据着图西亚丘陵中的一处巨大火山洼地。罗马人以一座古代伊特鲁里亚城市之名称它为沃尔西尼湖。湖的南部水域中有两座岛屿，是洼地形成后湖底喷发所造。雨水、地表径流和地下水补给湖泊，湖水则经马尔塔河南流。古代卡西亚大道从湖岸旁经过。

english: Lake Bolshoye Rovkulskoye lies among the forests and waters of western Karelia. It stretches from northwest to southeast, its four broad reaches joined by narrow straits. A channel connects it with the neighbouring Lake Rovkulskoye, while its waters drain through a chain of lakes and rivers toward Lake Pielinen. This is a landscape of intertwined waterways, with bays, islands and passages breaking up the outline of the lakes.
simp_chinese: 大罗夫库尔湖坐落在卡累利阿西部的森林与湖泊之间。湖身由西北向东南延伸，四片开阔水面由狭窄水道连接。一条水道将它与邻近的罗夫库尔湖相连，湖水又经一连串河湖流向皮耶利宁湖。这里的水网彼此交织，湖湾、岛屿和水道使湖岸轮廓曲折多变。

english: Böön Tsagaan Lake fills an enclosed basin between the Khangai and Gobi Altai mountains. Its chief inflow, the Baidrag River, descends from the southern slopes of the Khangai, but no surface river flows out of the lake. Plains and dunes surround the water, and old shorelines above its banks show that the lake once stood higher. Winter ice covers the lake until spring.
simp_chinese: 本查干湖位于杭爱山与戈壁阿尔泰山之间的封闭盆地。主要来水拜德拉格河从杭爱山南坡流下，湖泊却没有地表出流。平原和沙丘环绕湖水，湖岸上方的古岸线显示湖面曾经更加高涨。冬季湖面封冻，直至春天。

english: Lake Bracciano lies northwest of Rome in a basin formed by ancient volcanic activity. Bracciano, Anguillara and Trevignano stand around its shores, while the Arrone carries its waters toward the sea. In Roman times villas lined parts of the lakeside, and the Aqua Traiana carried water from the surrounding hills to Rome. Pope Paul V restored the aqueduct in the early seventeenth century, bringing water once more to the city across the Tiber.
simp_chinese: 布拉恰诺湖位于罗马西北，坐落在古代火山活动形成的盆地中。布拉恰诺、安圭拉拉和特雷维尼亚诺环绕湖岸，阿罗内河将湖水引向大海。罗马时代，湖岸部分地段建有别墅，图拉真引水道则将周围丘陵的水送往罗马。十七世纪初，教皇保禄五世修复了引水道，使水再次流向台伯河对岸的罗马城区。

english: Lake Buir is a broad freshwater lake on the eastern Mongolian steppe. The Khalkh River enters through a delta of reeds, willows and wet grassland, while the Orshuun River flows out towards the north. Sand dunes and smaller lakes lie near its southern shore. The lake freezes from autumn into spring, and its waters and surrounding marshes support fish and large numbers of migrating birds, including swan geese and cranes.
simp_chinese: 贝尔湖是蒙古东部草原上一座宽阔的淡水湖。喀尔喀河流经芦苇、柳树和湿草甸构成的三角洲注入湖中，乌尔逊河则向北流出。湖的南岸附近有沙丘和小湖泊，湖水从秋季封冻至春季。湖泊与周围沼泽养育鱼类，也为鸿雁、鹤等大群迁徙鸟类提供栖息地。

english:
Lake Burdur occupies a closed basin in southwestern Anatolia's lake district. Its saline waters lie among hills and plains, while streams and springs supply freshwater to the surrounding settlements. The town of Burdur stands to the southeast, beside a stream that flows towards the lake.

Burdur and the surrounding district formed part of the Hamid principality in the later medieval period. In 1391, Bayezid I incorporated the principality into Ottoman territory, bringing Burdur under Ottoman rule. The lake remained a prominent feature of the basin beside the town, fields and roads that connected this part of inland Anatolia.
simp_chinese:
布尔杜尔湖位于安纳托利亚西南湖区的封闭盆地。湖水含盐，周围是丘陵和平原；溪流与泉水为附近聚落提供淡水。布尔杜尔城位于湖的东南侧，城旁溪流向湖中流去。

中世纪后期，布尔杜尔及周边地区属于哈米德侯国。1391年，巴耶济德一世将该侯国并入奥斯曼领土，布尔杜尔也进入奥斯曼统治之下。湖泊与城镇、田地和道路共同构成这片安纳托利亚内陆盆地的景观。

english:
Lake Burullus lies along the Mediterranean edge of the Nile Delta, between the sea and cultivated land. Its shallow waters and reed marshes form a landscape connected to surrounding settlements and waterways.

Archaeological surveys around the lagoon have found late Roman and medieval Islamic sites. Finds near Baltim suggest settlement developed on the northwestern side from around the twelfth century, while older sites in the southern marshes may have been connected to earlier waterway networks. The changing wetland landscape shaped where communities could live and travel.
simp_chinese:
布鲁卢斯湖位于尼罗河三角洲面向地中海的边缘，介于海洋和耕地之间。浅水与芦苇沼泽构成与周围聚落、水道相连的景观。

环湖考古调查发现了罗马晚期和伊斯兰中世纪遗址。巴尔蒂姆附近的发现显示，潟湖西北岸可能从十二世纪左右开始发展聚落；南部沼泽更早的遗址则可能与早期水道网络有关。不断变化的湿地环境影响人们居住和通行的地点。

english: Lake Caniapiscau lies in the northern interior of the Labrador peninsula, among the headwaters of the river that flows towards Ungava Bay. Hunters and fur traders travelled through this lake country, part of a wider homeland where Naskapi people relied above all on caribou. In 1834 the Hudson's Bay Company opened an outpost at the lake to connect its establishments around James Bay with those on Ungava Bay, extending a trade route across the peninsula.
simp_chinese: 卡尼亚皮斯考湖位于拉布拉多半岛北部内陆，附近的河流向昂加瓦湾流去。猎人和毛皮商人往来于这一湖区；它属于更广阔的原住民故土，纳斯卡皮人的生活尤其依靠驯鹿。1834年，哈得孙湾公司在湖边建立商站，连接詹姆斯湾与昂加瓦湾地区的据点，使一条贸易路线横贯半岛。

english:
Lake Chad is a shallow inland lake on the southern edge of the Sahara. The Chari and Logone bring water from the south, while the Komadugu Yobe enters from the west. Its shores and islands change with the level of the water, and reeds and marshes fringe parts of the lake. Fishing communities, cultivators and herders have long lived around its basin.

The lake gave its name and setting to the kingdoms of Kanem and Bornu. In the fourteenth century, the Sayfawa rulers lost their capital Njimi east of the lake to the Bilala and shifted their centre of power to Bornu on the western side. They later recovered Kanem, but the court remained at Ngazargamu, the capital founded in Bornu in the fifteenth century.
simp_chinese:
乍得湖是撒哈拉南缘的一片浅内陆湖。沙里河和洛贡河从南方带来水流，科马杜古约贝河则从西面汇入。湖岸与岛屿随水位变化，部分湖边生长着芦苇和沼泽植物；渔民、农民和牧民长期生活在湖盆周围。

湖泊是加涅姆与博尔努诸王国共同的地理中心。十四世纪，赛法瓦统治者失去了湖东的都城恩吉米，被比拉拉人驱逐，遂将权力中心迁至西岸的博尔努。他们后来收复加涅姆，但宫廷仍留在十五世纪于博尔努建立的都城恩加扎尔加穆。

english:
Chagan Lake lies in the Songnen plain, in the country of the Gorlos Mongols. Its Mongolian name, Chagan Nuur, means White Lake, and local traditions also give its waters a sacred character. Fishing connected the lake's seasonal resources with the life of communities around its shores. Winter ice provided the setting for a distinctive fishing tradition in which the opening of the season was accompanied by offerings to the lake and the ceremonial awakening of the nets.

These rites joined the work of fishermen to Mongolian practices of honouring heaven, mountains and water. The lake's religious landscape acquired another institution in the Qing period. In 1755 the reincarnate lama Yundanzhamsu of the Gorlos Front Banner founded Miaoyin Temple beside the lake to honour the Qianlong emperor's birthday. The temple received an imperial plaque in Manchu, Mongolian, Tibetan and Chinese. Its foundation placed Tibetan Buddhist patronage alongside older lake-centred observances. Through the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries, the shores thus belonged to a regional world in which fisheries, Mongolian community traditions and Qing Buddhist institutions met around the same body of water.
simp_chinese:
查干湖位于松嫩平原的郭尔罗斯蒙古地域。“查干淖尔”在蒙古语中意为白湖，地方传统也赋予湖水神圣意义。渔业把湖泊的季节资源与岸边社群生活联系起来，冬季冰面则成为独特捕捞传统的活动场所。开捕时，人们祭祀湖泊，并以醒网仪式迎接新一季劳作。

这些仪式把渔民劳动与蒙古人祭天、祭山、祭水的习俗相连。清代，湖岸又增添佛教机构。1755年，郭尔罗斯前旗的云丹扎木苏活佛为庆贺乾隆皇帝寿辰，在湖旁创建妙因寺，获赐满文、蒙古文、藏文与汉文四体字匾额。寺院建立后，藏传佛教赞助与较早的湖泊祭祀传统同处一地。十八世纪至十九世纪前期，湖岸由此属于一处渔业、蒙古社群传统与清代佛教机构相互交汇的区域世界，生产活动和信仰都围绕同一片水域展开。

english:
Lake Champlain forms a long water corridor between the St Lawrence country and the valleys leading toward the Hudson. Indigenous peoples used its shores and routes for fishing, hunting, travel, and diplomacy long before Europeans named it. Canoes and portages linked the lake with neighboring waterways, making it part of a broader network rather than an isolated body of water. The surrounding forests and cultivable ground supplied resources to communities whose relationships crossed the region.

Samuel de Champlain reached the lake in 1609 amid French alliances and conflict with the Haudenosaunee. In 1755 French forces began Fort Carillon near its southern end to defend the corridor; British troops took it in 1759 and renamed it Ticonderoga. American forces captured the fort in 1775 during the Revolutionary War. These successive struggles made use of a water route that Indigenous communities had long known and traveled.
simp_chinese:
尚普兰湖形成连接圣劳伦斯河地区与通向哈得孙河谷的狭长水上走廊。欧洲人命名以前，原住民早已利用湖岸和路线捕鱼、狩猎、旅行及外交。独木舟与搬舟陆路把湖泊同邻近水系相连，使其属于更广大网络。周围森林和可耕土地为社群提供资源，人际关系跨越地区延伸，水道长期支持生活与往来。

1609年塞缪尔·德·尚普兰抵达湖区时，法国与原住民的联盟及同霍迪诺肖尼的冲突已交织在一起。1755年，法军在湖的南端附近开始修建卡里永堡，以防守这一通道；英军于1759年夺取并将其改称提康德罗加堡。1775年，美国独立战争期间，美军占领该堡。这些接连发生的争斗利用了原住民长期熟悉并通行的水路。

english: Dotted with islands and divided by projecting shores, Lake Chibougamau drains westward through the Chibougamau River towards the Waswanipi. Cree families have long hunted around this lake and neighbouring Lake Opémisca. Between 1815 and 1822, the Hudson's Bay Company maintained a trading post at Lake Chevrillon on the river downstream. The meaning of Chibougamau has been variously explained; one interpretation connects it with a narrow passage where the water appears blocked.
simp_chinese: 希布加莫湖中岛屿星罗棋布，突出的湖岸将水面分成数片。湖水经希布加莫河向西流往瓦斯瓦尼皮河。克里人的家族长期在湖泊及邻近的奥佩米斯卡湖一带狩猎；1815至1822年间，哈德逊湾公司在下游舍夫里永湖设有商站。希布加莫这一名称有多种解释，其中一种将它与水流仿佛被阻断的狭窄水道联系起来。

english: Chiemsee is a great freshwater lake in the Bavarian Alpine foreland, fed by the Tiroler Achen and Prien and drained northward by the Alz. Among its islands are Herrenchiemsee, once the site of an Augustinian monastery, and Frauenchiemsee, home to a Benedictine convent founded by Duke Tassilo III in 782. The convent's buildings were rebuilt between 1728 and 1732. Secularisation disrupted the community in 1803; King Ludwig I restored it to the Benedictine nuns in 1837.
simp_chinese: 基姆湖是巴伐利亚阿尔卑斯前陆的一座大淡水湖，蒂罗尔阿亨河与普里恩河注入湖中，阿尔茨河向北流出。湖上有赫伦基姆湖岛，岛上曾有奥斯定会修道院；弗劳恩基姆湖岛则有一座本笃会女修道院，由塔西洛三世公爵于782年创建。修道院建筑于1728至1732年重建，1803年的世俗化打断了修女们的生活；1837年，国王路德维希一世将其恢复为本笃会女修道院。

english: Lake Chilwa lies in a broad basin east of the Shire Highlands. The Likangala, Domasi and Phalombe rivers feed its shallow waters and surrounding marshes, but no river carries water out. Its shoreline advances and retreats with the rains, and the lake can dry up in years of drought. Chisi is one of several islands within the lake. Fish and waterbirds flourish among the reeds when the lake fills.
simp_chinese: 奇尔瓦湖位于希雷高地以东的宽阔盆地里。利坎加拉河、多马西河和法隆贝河注入浅湖及周围沼泽，却没有河流从湖中流出。湖岸随降雨进退，干旱年份湖水可能干涸。奇西岛是湖中的数座岛屿之一。湖水充盈时，鱼类与水鸟在芦苇丛间繁盛。

english:
Lake Chiya belongs to the lower Amur country, where lakes, river channels and wetlands connect the inland basin with its estuary. Fishing supplied a major part of life for communities along these waters, while hunting and gathered foods added to household resources. Seasonal changes in ice, water level and fish movements shaped work and travel. Boats linked settlements during the open season, and winter routes could cross surfaces that were difficult to pass at other times.

The wider lower Amur region contained diverse peoples whose languages and customs differed while their livelihoods shared close ties to rivers. Exchange carried fish products, furs and useful materials between inland and coastal places. During the early modern period, Manchu and Qing power developed claims and relationships across the basin, while Russian expansion introduced competing interests farther upstream. Local leaders and traders mediated contacts with distant authorities.
simp_chinese:
奇亚湖属于阿穆尔河下游地区，湖泊、河道与湿地把内陆流域同河口连接起来。捕鱼是沿水居民生活的重要部分，狩猎和采集食物补充家庭资源。冰情、水位和鱼群移动的季节变化，影响劳动与旅行。无冰时船只联系聚落，冬季道路则能越过其他时候难以通行的水面，居民需熟悉一年各阶段的交通条件。

更广阔的下阿穆尔地区居住着不同族群，语言和习俗虽有差异，生计都与河流密切相关。鱼产品、毛皮和实用材料在内陆与沿海之间交换。近代早期，满洲及清朝势力在流域建立联系并提出领土主张，俄国扩张则在更上游带来竞争利益。地方领袖和商人居间协调与远方政权的接触。

english: Chudzjavr is a lake in the centre of the Kola Peninsula, its name preserved in Kildin Sámi. Its irregular shores are steep in the west and southwest, and snow and rain feed its waters. The Chudzyok flows out to join the Voronya, carrying water ultimately to the Barents Sea. Around the lake lie the tundra and forests of the peninsula's interior, crossed by rivers descending towards the northern coast.
simp_chinese: 丘贾夫尔湖位于科拉半岛中部，湖名保留了基尔丁萨米语。曲折湖岸的西部和西南部较为陡峭，湖水主要来自雨雪。丘济约克河从湖中流出，汇入沃罗尼亚河，最终通向巴伦支海。湖周围是半岛内陆的苔原和森林，河流穿过这里流向北岸。

english: Lake Chukchagir is a broad, shallow freshwater lake in the Amgun basin. Its winding shores are low and marshy in the north, while wooded islands rise above the water. Two large islands, Dzhalu and Godbanki, divide the lake into three open reaches, and floating mats of vegetation form islands of their own. The Oldzhikan flows out of the lake to join the Amgun; ice covers the water from late autumn until spring.
simp_chinese: 楚克查吉尔湖是恒滚河流域一座宽阔而浅的淡水湖。湖岸蜿蜒，北岸低洼多沼，湖中林木覆盖的岛屿高出水面。贾卢岛和戈德班基岛将湖面分为三个开阔水域，漂浮的植物团也形成小岛。奥尔吉坎河从湖中流出，汇入恒滚河；湖水从深秋封冻，直到春季解冻。

english: Lake Çıldır fills a high basin among the mountains of northeastern Anatolia, near the upper Kura country. This broad freshwater lake lies nearly two thousand meters above sea level and freezes in winter; the surrounding uplands are better suited to grazing than cultivation. An island near its shore preserves traces of ancient settlement. In 1578 the lake gave its name to a battle in which an Ottoman army advancing into the Caucasus defeated Safavid forces, opening the way towards Tbilisi.
simp_chinese: 奇尔德尔湖位于安纳托利亚东北部群山之间的高盆地，靠近库拉河上游地区。这片广阔的淡水湖海拔近两千米，冬季结冰；周围的高地更适合放牧，而非耕作。湖岸附近的一座岛屿上保存着古代聚落的痕迹。1578年，向高加索推进的奥斯曼军队在一场以此湖命名的战役中击败萨法维军队，打开了通往第比利斯的道路。

english: Lake Claire lies west of Lake Athabasca in a vast freshwater delta of channels, marshes and shallow lakes. The Birch River enters its western side, while waterways connect it with Mamawi Lake and the larger Peace-Athabasca system. When the rivers rise, water spreads over the lake margins and into surrounding wetlands. Fish and great numbers of waterbirds find habitat in this landscape, which has sustained Indigenous communities for centuries.
simp_chinese: 克莱尔湖位于阿萨巴斯卡湖以西，是一片广阔淡水三角洲的一部分，周围水道、沼泽和浅湖交错。伯奇河从西侧注入湖中，水道又将它与马马维湖及更大的皮斯—阿萨巴斯卡水系相连。河水上涨时，湖水漫过岸边，流入周围湿地。鱼类与众多水鸟栖息于此，原住民社群也数百年来依靠这片水域生活。

english:
Lake Como's upper western shore became the centre of an armed lordship in the early sixteenth century. Gian Giacomo Medici, known as the Medeghino, established himself at Musso and strengthened the fortress above the water. Defences extended from the lakeside to the rocky height, with a ditch cut into the rock protecting the rear. A fleet helped him project power across the lake and toward neighbouring Alpine approaches.

His rule ended in 1532, when forces allied with Francesco II Sforza and the Swiss and Grisons compelled his departure. Most of the fortress was destroyed. The struggle also changed the government of lakeside communities: the three parishes of Gravedona, Sorico and Dongo gained a separate judicial administration, forming the nucleus of the later Contado of Como. The lake's waters thus connected fortified shores and communities whose security and jurisdiction could be reshaped by control of a single stronghold. Boats and shore roads carried the consequences of these rivalries around the lake.
simp_chinese:
十六世纪初，科莫湖西北岸成为一处武装领地的中心。绰号梅代吉诺的詹·贾科莫·美第奇据守穆索，加固临湖堡垒。防御工事由水边延伸至岩石高处，岩中开凿壕沟保护后方；舰队则帮助他向湖区及邻近阿尔卑斯通道施加权力。

其统治在1532年结束：与弗朗切斯科二世·斯福尔扎及瑞士、格劳宾登相联系的联军迫使他离去，堡垒大部被毁。争夺也改变湖岸社群的治理，格拉韦多纳、索里科和栋戈三教区获得单独司法行政，成为后来科莫乡区的核心。湖水将设防岸段与社群相连，一座要塞的控制权就可能改变居民的安全与辖属；舟船和岸上道路又把这些竞争的影响带往湖泊各处。

english: At the northern foot of the Alps, Lake Constance lies in a basin carved by the Rhine Glacier. The Alpine Rhine enters at its southeastern end, and the river continues west through the Upper and Lower Lakes. The peninsula of Bodanrück separates the two stretches of water; Reichenau lies in the Lower Lake, while Lindau and Mainau are islands in the Upper Lake. The lake's German name, Bodensee, comes from Bodman, once the site of a Frankish royal palace at the western end of the lake.
simp_chinese: 博登湖位于阿尔卑斯山北麓，坐落在莱茵冰川开凿的盆地之中。阿尔卑斯莱茵河从东南端流入，向西穿过上湖与下湖继续流淌。博丹吕克半岛将两片水域分开；赖兴瑙岛位于下湖，林道岛和迈瑙岛则位于上湖。湖泊的德语名称博登湖得名于西端的博德曼，那里曾有一座法兰克王室行宫。

english: Lake Dalzha lies on the left side of the lower Amgun, in a lowland of lakes and river channels. This elongated freshwater lake stretches from northeast to southwest, receiving the Dzhuk and Kalpakori rivers. Its water reaches the Amgun through neighbouring Lake Dalgan and a channel, joining the lower Amur system. Around it lie marshy shores and the small floodplain lakes left by shifting watercourses.
simp_chinese: 达尔扎湖位于恒滚河下游左岸的低地，周围湖泊和水道交错。这座狭长的淡水湖自东北向西南延伸，接纳朱克河与卡尔帕科里河的水流，再经相邻的达尔甘湖和水道通往恒滚河，属于黑龙江下游水系。湖边地势低湿，附近散布着河道变迁留下的泛滥湖。

english: Dauphin Lake lies below the wooded slopes of Riding Mountain and Duck Mountain in western Manitoba. Rivers descending from the highlands enter its shallow waters, which drain north toward Lake Winnipegosis. Its shores and marshes have long provided fish, waterbirds and other resources to Indigenous communities. The lake was a gathering place and formed part of a network of waterways through the parkland between the prairie and the northern forests.
simp_chinese: 多芬湖位于曼尼托巴西部赖丁山与达克山的林木山坡下。高地流下的河流注入这片浅水，湖水向北流往温尼伯戈西斯湖。湖岸与沼泽长期以来为原住民社群提供鱼类、水鸟和其他资源。湖泊是人们聚集的地方，也是贯穿草原与北方森林之间公园林地的水道网络的一部分。

english: Dayan Lake lies among the high mountains of the Mongolian Altai. Its cold waters remain frozen for much of the year, usually from October until June. Together with neighbouring Khoton and Khurgan lakes, it feeds the Khovd River, which flows east towards the Great Lakes Depression. Wolves, foxes and Pallas's cats inhabit the surrounding country, while birds nest around the lake and its neighbour Khar Lake.
simp_chinese: 达延湖坐落在蒙古阿尔泰山的高山之间，寒冷的湖水通常从十月封冻到次年六月。它与邻近的霍顿湖、呼尔干湖共同为科布多河供水，河流向东流向大湖盆地。湖周围的山野有狼、狐狸和兔狲出没，达延湖与附近的哈尔湖岸边也是鸟类筑巢的地方。

english:
Dood Tsagaan, the Lower White Lake, lies in the Darkhad basin of northern Mongolia. The Shishged River enters and leaves the lake, carrying its waters toward the Little Yenisei. Several connected waters have also been distinguished by the names Targan, Dund and Kharmai. This lake-and-river landscape belongs to the wider Khuvsgul–Sayan country, where the histories of forest peoples, Mongolian lords and religious authorities crossed the routes through the mountains.

In the seventeenth century, Darkhad communities in the broader region were subjects whose allegiance and tribute were contested by Mongolian nobles and the expanding Russian state. Geleg Noyan Qutugtu, a lama of the Khotogoid ruling family, took an active part in these frontier struggles. Darkhad traditions also connect their community's status with service to the first Jebtsundamba, Zanabazar, and with exemption from certain taxes and obligations. Buddhist authority consequently became one strand of regional social organisation alongside older shamanic practices. The lake's historical setting was therefore a northern Mongolian basin connected to a wider religious and political frontier, with lake, river and surrounding uplands providing the setting in which these competing affiliations took shape.
simp_chinese:
多德查干湖意为“下白湖”，位于蒙古北部的达尔哈特盆地。希什盖德河流入又流出湖泊，最终通向小叶尼塞河；相连的水面也分别称作塔尔干、敦德和哈日迈。这片湖河景观属于更广阔的库苏古尔—萨彦地域，林地居民、蒙古领主与宗教权威的历史，沿山间路线相互交织。

十七世纪，较大区域内达尔哈特社群的归属与贡赋，成为蒙古贵族和扩张中的俄国争夺的对象。出身和托辉特统治家族的格列格诺颜呼图克图，是参与这些边地斗争的喇嘛。达尔哈特传统还将社群身份与侍奉第一世哲布尊丹巴扎那巴扎尔、获得部分赋役豁免相联系。佛教权威因而与较早的萨满实践一同构成区域社会组织。湖泊的历史背景，是连接宗教与政治边地的蒙古北部盆地，湖面、河道和周围高地构成不同归属关系交织的实际环境。

sources.title: 270530599 Geleg Noyan Qutugtu and His Darkhad Subjects from the Khuvsgul-Sayan Region

english: Durgun is a salt lake in the Great Lakes Depression of western Mongolia. It lies south of Khar Lake, with which its waters are connected, amid a broad basin between mountain ranges. Both are remnants of a much larger prehistoric lake that contracted as the region became drier. Durgun's saline water distinguishes it from some of the freshwater lakes in this remarkable chain of inland basins.
simp_chinese: 杜尔贡湖是蒙古西部大湖盆地中的一座盐湖，位于哈尔湖南面，两湖水系相通，坐落在群山之间的宽广盆地中。它们都是一座更大的史前湖泊的残余；随着地区气候变干，那座古湖逐渐退缩。杜尔贡的咸水使它有别于这片内陆湖群中的一些淡水湖。

english: Lake Dvinye lies in the lake country southwest of Toropets, near Lake Zhizhitskoye. It is connected to Lake Velinskoye, from which the Dvinka flows toward the Western Dvina. Its low shores, islands and neighbouring waters form a landscape of interconnected lakes within the Baltic drainage basin. The nearby district was associated with the old Toropets lands, where lakes and rivers formed routes between scattered communities and the larger towns of the region.
simp_chinese: 德维尼耶湖位于托罗佩茨西南的湖区，靠近日日茨科耶湖。它与韦林斯科耶湖相连，德文卡河从后者流出，通往西德维纳河。低矮湖岸、岛屿和邻近水域构成波罗的海流域中相互连接的湖泊景观。附近地区曾属于古老的托罗佩茨诸地，湖泊与河流构成分散社群和地区大城之间的通道。

english: Lake Eber lies in the Akarçay basin north of the Sultan Mountains. Streams descending from the range feed its shallow fresh waters, where extensive reed beds shelter fish and birds. When the lake rises, water passes toward neighbouring Lake Akşehir. The marshes and open water form a wetland amid the inland plains of western Anatolia, close to the roads between Afyon and Akşehir.
simp_chinese: 埃贝尔湖位于苏丹山脉以北的阿卡尔恰伊盆地。山间溪流注入浅淡水湖，大片芦苇丛为鱼类和鸟类提供庇护。湖水上涨时，可流向邻近的阿克谢希尔湖。沼泽与开阔水面在安纳托利亚西部内陆平原构成一片湿地，靠近阿菲永与阿克谢希尔之间的道路。

english:
Lake Edward lay within a regional economy linking fishing waters, farming country and specialised salt sources. The salt lakes of Katwe and Kisenyi nearby must be distinguished from Lake Edward itself. By at least 1750, an extensive commercial network had developed around these works in the Lake Edward–Lake George region.

The products served different needs: fine white salt from Kisenyi was reserved for chiefs, while other grades supplied cooking and livestock. The works could be used throughout the year, unlike sources limited to a dry-season harvest, and nearby ironworking centres supported the regional economy. Tradition credited a hunter named Murogo with discovering Katwe’s salt; his descendants became ritual heads of the works. Salt production thus connected material exchange with hereditary ritual responsibilities around the lake country.
simp_chinese:
爱德华湖处在一个连接渔业水域、农耕地区与专门盐源的区域经济之中。邻近的卡特韦和基塞尼盐湖应与爱德华湖本身区分。至少到1750年，爱德华湖—乔治湖地区已围绕这些盐场形成广泛的商业网络。

不同盐品满足不同需要：基塞尼出产的精细白盐专供首领，其他等级用于烹饪或供牲畜食用。盐场全年可以生产，具有不受旱季采收限制的优势，附近的冶铁中心也参与这一地区经济。地方传统将卡特韦盐源的发现归于猎人穆罗戈，其后裔成为盐场的仪式负责人。制盐由此把物质交换与世袭的仪式责任联系起来。

sources.title: john e. flint the cambridge history of africa vbook4you.pdf

english:
Lake Eğirdir lies among the uplands of southwestern Anatolia, where freshwater and cultivated shore land supported settlement in a predominantly mountainous environment. Fishing and agriculture supplied communities around the basin, while routes along the shore connected neighboring valleys. The lake's irregular outline and surrounding heights influenced travel, encouraging movement through particular passages. Its waters provided a durable resource in a region whose farming depended on careful use of seasonal rainfall and local supplies.

The surrounding country passed through classical, Byzantine, and Turkish political worlds. Under the Hamidid rulers and later the Ottomans, nearby towns formed part of networks linking inland Anatolia with routes toward the Mediterranean. Markets and local institutions drew on the production of villages, orchards, and fields around the lake. Political change altered authority and taxation, while the basin remained important to local livelihoods.
simp_chinese:
埃里迪尔湖位于安纳托利亚西南高地，淡水与沿岸耕地在山地环境中支持聚落。捕鱼和农业供应湖盆周围社群，岸边路线连接邻近河谷。不规则岸线及周围山岭影响出行，使人员集中经过特定通道。这里的农业需要谨慎利用季节降雨与地方水源，湖水因而成为持久而重要的生活资源。

周边地区先后经历古典时代诸政权、拜占庭和突厥统治。哈米德王朝及后来的奥斯曼统治时期，附近城镇参与连接安纳托利亚内陆与地中海方向的交通网络。市场和地方机构依靠湖畔村落、果园及田地的产出。政治变化改变了权力和税收，湖盆仍是居民生计的重要基础。

english: Wadi El Rayan is a desert depression southwest of the Faiyum basin. Wind and water have shaped its sandy ground and exposed layers of rock, while the cliffs and valleys around it preserve fossils from an ancient sea. Beyond the cultivated lands fed by the Bahr Yussef, this dry basin formed part of the Western Desert's open landscape. Its low ground and surrounding escarpments give it a distinct shape within the desert plateau.
simp_chinese: 瓦迪赖扬是法尤姆盆地西南方的沙漠洼地。风和水塑造了沙地与裸露岩层，周围崖壁和河谷保存着古海洋的化石。优素福河渠滋养的耕地之外，这片干燥盆地属于西部沙漠的开阔地貌。低洼地面与四周崖坡使它在沙漠高原中呈现独特轮廓。

english: Engozero is a freshwater lake in northern Karelia, with an intricate shoreline of bays, islands and peninsulas. The Kalga leaves its eastern waters and runs to the White Sea, passing through a chain of smaller lakes. The lake sits within a broad forested drainage basin, where channels link open stretches of water with narrower rivers. Its Karelian name, Enkijärvi, preserves the language of the region's inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 恩戈泽罗是卡累利阿北部的淡水湖，海湾、岛屿和半岛使湖岸十分曲折。卡尔加河从东部湖水流出，穿过一连串较小湖泊后注入白海。此湖坐落在森林覆盖的广阔流域中，水道连接开阔湖面与狭窄河流。卡累利阿语名恩基湖保留了当地居民的语言痕迹。

english: Chisesaakahikan, the “big lake” in Cree, is a great widening of the Broadback River in the marshy country southeast of James Bay. Its waters receive the Théodat River from the east before the Broadback continues west to Rupert Bay. The river has borne different names along its course; the Cree name Paachipiskunew-siipiy refers to a swollen back. Forests and wetlands surround the broad lake.
simp_chinese: 希塞萨卡希坎在克里语中意为“大湖”，是布罗德巴克河在詹姆斯湾东南沼泽地区的一处广阔水面。泰奥达河从东面流入湖泊，布罗德巴克河则继续向西流往鲁珀特湾。河流沿途曾有不同名称；克里语名 Paachipiskunew-siipiy 意为“背部鼓起的河”。宽阔湖面四周分布着森林和湿地。

english: Lake Evoron is a shallow freshwater lake in the lowland between the Amgun and the lower Amur. Several rivers enter it, the largest being the Evur; the Devyatka carries its waters towards the Gorin and the Amur. Small islands lie near its southern and eastern shores. The name is associated with a Negidal word for a large flowing lake, while geese and herons nest along its shores and other birds visit on migration.
simp_chinese: 埃沃隆湖是恒滚河与黑龙江下游之间低地中的浅淡水湖。多条河流注入湖中，其中最大的是额乌尔河；杰维亚特卡河则将湖水带向戈林河与黑龙江。湖的南岸和东岸附近散布着小岛。湖名与尼吉达尔语中“大型通流水湖”的词语有关；灰雁和苍鹭在岸边筑巢，其他鸟类也在迁徙途中到访。

english:
Lake Eyasi lies in northern Tanzania's Rift landscape, beside country long occupied by hunting, gathering, herding and farming communities. Archaeological research in its basin reveals interactions between foragers and food producers extending back roughly three millennia. The lake therefore belongs to a much longer history of contact than the nineteenth-century accounts through which it entered European geographical writing.

The Hadza are closely associated with the country around Eyasi. Their subsistence has drawn on wild animals, honey, fruits and edible plants, with camps moving as resources and circumstances changed. The basin also became a meeting ground for speakers of different languages and practitioners of different livelihoods. A precise political narrative for its shores in the years 1337–1837 remains difficult to reconstruct from surviving written records. Its historical character is more securely approached through the archaeological evidence for coexistence and exchange, alongside the enduring Hadza relationship with the surrounding landscape, than through a succession of named rulers or towns.
simp_chinese:
