simp_chinese: 扎日姆恰尔河向西流经鄂毕河下游以东的湿地，沿途接纳涅马利约甘河和绍马约甘河。接近河口时，它汇入鄂毕河泛滥平原的一条水道。浅水与河道遍布低地，随春季洪水和漫长冬季冰封而变化。这条河属于西西伯利亚北部流向喀拉海的庞大水系。

english: Segozero lies in central Karelia northwest of Onega. The Segezha flows from the lake towards Vygozero, linking its waters with the route of the Vyg to the White Sea. Travellers with boats and goods could cross a short watershed into Segozero and continue downriver; routes westward led towards the Peninga and Leksozero. Rivers entering the lake include the Voloma and Luzhma, each reaching into the forested interior.
simp_chinese: 谢戈泽罗湖位于卡累利阿中部、奥涅加湖西北。谢盖扎河从湖中流向维戈泽罗湖，将这里与沿维格河通往白海的路线连接起来。旅人可以搬运船只和货物越过一段短距离分水岭进入谢戈泽罗，再顺河而下；向西的路线则通往佩宁加河和列克索泽罗湖。注入此湖的河流包括沃洛马和卢日马，它们伸入森林覆盖的内陆。

english: Zhalauly is a shallow salt lake at the southern edge of the Ishim plain. It consists of a broad western basin and a smaller eastern one joined near their northern ends. Marshes and salt flats fringe its irregular shores. In dry periods the lake may shrink greatly, while exceptional snowmelt can send water from the Shiderti system through neighbouring Shyganak into its basin.
simp_chinese: 扎拉乌雷湖是伊希姆平原南缘的一座浅盐湖，由较大的西部湖盆与较小的东部湖盆组成，两者在北端附近相连。沼泽和盐滩环绕曲折的湖岸；干旱时湖水可能大幅退缩，积雪特别丰沛的年份，希杰尔提水系的水则可能经由邻近的希加纳克湖注入湖盆。

english: Zharkol lies among the lakes of the northern Kazakh steppe, near the Tobol basin. In this flat country, shallow depressions hold scattered bodies of water among grassland and cultivated plains. The nearby lake of Qonayzharkol bears the same final name and lies close to this part of the steppe; burial mounds in its vicinity bear witness to the long human presence in the region.
simp_chinese: 扎尔科尔湖位于哈萨克北部草原的众多湖泊之间，靠近托博尔河流域。平坦地带的浅洼中散布着水域，周围是草地和平原。邻近的科奈扎尔科尔湖名称也以扎尔科尔结尾；其附近的古墓冢见证了这一地区悠久的人类活动。

english: Lake Zhizhitskoye is a brackish lake in the wooded Pskov country, the second largest lake in the region after Lake Peipus. It has an irregular shape with many islands, and its fish gave it particular value: zander from the lake were reportedly sent regularly to the tsar in Moscow.
simp_chinese: 日日茨科耶湖是普斯科夫地区林间的一片微咸水湖，是该地区仅次于佩普西湖的第二大湖。湖形不规则，岛屿众多，湖中鱼类使其颇有价值：据载，湖中的梭鲈曾定期作为贡品送往莫斯科献给沙皇。

english: Lake Zurich stretches southeast from the city of Zürich towards the Alps. Its shores have been inhabited since prehistoric times; the Romans maintained settlements at Turicum and Centum Prata, near opposite ends of the lake. At its narrow upper end, the peninsula of Hurden reaches towards Rapperswil. A wooden bridge completed in 1360 crossed this neck of water and carried travellers along a pilgrimage route for centuries.
simp_chinese: 苏黎世湖从苏黎世城向东南方延伸，朝着阿尔卑斯山展开。湖岸自史前时代便有人居住；罗马人在湖的两端附近分别设有图里库姆和肯图姆普拉塔聚落。湖的上游有一处狭窄水道，胡尔登半岛伸向拉珀斯维尔。1360年建成的木桥跨越这段水面，数百年来承载着朝圣路上的旅人。

english: Zuun Tooroi is the eastern of the two Torey Lakes, lying in a closed basin in the Daurian steppe. A channel connects it with Barun-Torey to the west, though the direction of flow changes with the water level. Both are shallow alkaline lakes whose size varies greatly with wet and dry cycles. Their wetlands provide nesting and resting grounds for cranes, geese and other migratory birds.
simp_chinese: 宗托洛依湖是托列伊双湖中靠东的一座，坐落在达乌尔草原的封闭盆地中。一条水道将它与西面的巴伦托列伊湖相连，水流方向随水位变化。两湖都浅而呈碱性，面积随干湿周期大幅变化；湖泊湿地为鹤、雁和其他候鸟提供筑巢与停歇之所。

english: Lakeba is a high island in the southern Lau group of eastern Fiji. Its position made it a meeting place for Fijians and Tongans, who crossed the sea to exchange goods and establish ties of marriage. The island became the centre of a chiefly power associated with the title Tui Nayau, whose influence reached other islands of southern Lau. Tongan visitors sought the valuable vesi timber of the Lau Islands, useful for building canoes, and Tongan connections became an important part of Lakeba’s history. In 1830 the first Christian missionaries reached the island but were expelled. The older relationships between chiefs, island communities and visitors from Tonga continued to shape the politics of the group.
simp_chinese: 莱凯巴是斐济东部南劳群岛的一座高岛。它是斐济人与汤加人的会面之地，来往者跨海交换物品，建立通婚关系。岛上形成了以图伊纳尧头衔为代表的酋长权力中心，其影响延及南劳群岛的其他岛屿。 汤加来客看重劳群岛的维西木材，这种木材适合建造独木舟，汤加联系也成为莱凯巴历史的重要部分。1830年，首批基督教传教士抵达该岛，却遭到驱逐。酋长、岛屿社群与汤加来客之间原有的关系，继续影响群岛政治。

english: Lakhimpur lies north of the Brahmaputra in the country watered by the Subansiri and its neighbouring rivers. This area formed part of the Chutia kingdom, whose land grants survive in copperplate inscriptions. A grant of King Lakshminarayan dated to 1401 records land west of the Subansiri. After the Ahom conquest of the Chutia kingdom, an officer known as the Bhatialia Gohain administered the region from Habung.
simp_chinese: 勒金布尔位于布拉姆普特拉河北岸，由苏班西里河及附近河流灌溉。这片地区曾属于久蒂亚王国，统治者的赐地文书以铜版铭文保存下来。1401年，拉克希米纳拉亚纳王的一份文书记载了苏班西里河以西的土地。阿洪征服久蒂亚王国后，一位称为巴蒂阿利亚·戈汉的官员从哈邦管理此地。

english: Lakhiyarvira lies in western Kutch, in a dry country of low hills and seasonal streams. Local tradition associates the settlement with the early Jadeja rulers, who established power in Kutch before their descendants founded states across Saurashtra. The region’s villages and grazing grounds were linked to the wider landscape between the Gulf of Kutch and the salt marshes of the Great Rann.
simp_chinese: 拉基亚尔维拉位于卡奇西部干旱地区，周围分布低丘与季节性溪流。当地传统将聚落与早期贾德贾统治者联系起来，他们在卡奇建立势力，后裔又在索拉什特拉各地创建邦国。这一带的村庄和牧场属于卡奇湾与大盐沼之间广阔地域景观的一部分。

english: Lakhpat stands beside the Kori Creek at the western edge of the Great Rann of Kutch. Its high stone walls and bastions guarded a frontier facing Sindh, where waterways and salt marshes change with the seasons. The Kutch general Fateh Muhammad fortified the town around the beginning of the nineteenth century. An earthquake in 1819 altered the surrounding land and watercourses, flooding and lowering areas near the creek and changing the conditions that had supported the port.
simp_chinese: 拉赫帕特位于卡奇大盐沼西缘的科里水道旁。高大的石墙和棱堡守卫面向信德的边界，水道与盐沼随季节变化。十九世纪初前后，卡奇将领法泰赫·穆罕默德为城镇修筑防御工事。1819年地震改变了周围地形和水道，使附近部分土地沉降、受淹，也改变了港口赖以发展的条件。

english: Lakhsar lies in the dry hills northwest of Bela in Baluchistan. Near Bela, the caves of Gondrani have been cut into conglomerate cliffs above the surrounding country. The chambers, known locally as Shahr-i-Rogan, belong to an old settlement whose origins have prompted differing interpretations. Their rock-cut rooms remain a distinctive feature of the Las Bela landscape.
simp_chinese: 拉克萨尔位于俾路支斯坦贝拉西北方的干旱丘陵。贝拉附近的贡德拉尼洞窟凿入高出周围地面的砾岩峭壁；这些石室在当地称作沙赫里罗甘，属于一处古老聚落。洞窟的起源有不同解释，其凿岩房间是拉斯贝拉地区独特的遗迹。

english: Lakhva lies in the river country of Polesia, south of Kletsk. Recorded in a document of 1493, it passed to Anna of the Kiszka family in 1523 and through her became associated with the Radziwiłłs. By 1589 it was described as a small town with a vogt. Jewish settlement began in the second half of the seventeenth century, adding another community to the life of the estate. Lakhva remained a Radziwiłł possession into the nineteenth century, when it passed to the Wittgenstein family through marriage.
simp_chinese: 拉赫瓦位于克列茨克以南的波列西亚河流地带。1493年的文书已记载此地；1523年，它分给基什卡家族的安娜，并通过她与拉齐维乌家族相联系。到1589年，拉赫瓦被称作设有地方长官的小镇。十七世纪后半叶，犹太人在此定居，为庄园生活增添了一个社群。拉赫瓦一直是拉齐维乌家族的地产，直到十九世纪通过婚姻转归维特根施泰因家族。

english: The Lakitan is a tributary of the Musi in the forested interior of southern Sumatra. Its waters descend from the western hills and join the larger river at Muara Lakitan, linking a network of smaller streams with the route towards Palembang. The river and its banks support fish and other wildlife, including the rare hairy-nosed otter. Seasonal rains can swell the waterways and spread water across the low ground beside their courses.
simp_chinese: 拉基坦河是苏门答腊南部森林内陆穆西河的一条支流。河水从西部丘陵流下，在穆阿拉拉基坦汇入大河，将众多小溪与通往巨港的路线相连。河流及两岸为鱼类和其他野生动物提供栖息地，其中包括罕见的苏门答腊水獭。季节性降雨可使河水上涨，漫入河道旁的低地。

english: The Lakitusaki River reaches the western shore of James Bay north of the Ekwan. Wide tidal marshes line this low coast, where Cree communities have long travelled and hunted. The river was associated with one of the groups of Mushkegowuk living along the shore. Farther north, Cape Henrietta Maria divides James Bay from Hudson Bay; travellers could avoid the exposed waters around the cape by taking inland routes between the Ekwan and Winisk rivers.
simp_chinese: 拉基图萨基河在埃克万河以北流至詹姆斯湾西岸，低平的海岸边分布着宽阔潮汐沼泽。克里社群长期在这一带旅行和狩猎，这条河与沿岸穆什凯戈乌克人的一个群体有关。更北面的亨丽埃塔玛丽亚角分开詹姆斯湾和哈得孙湾；旅人可取道埃克万河与维尼什克河之间的内陆路线，避开海角附近暴露的水域。

english: The Laconian Gulf cuts into the southern Peloponnese between the rocky Mani peninsula and Cape Maleas. The Eurotas River reaches the sea at the head of the gulf, where the fertile Laconian plain meets the coast. Gytheio lies on the gulf's northwestern shore, while the long peninsulas on either side extend southward toward exposed capes. Beyond Cape Maleas, the waters open toward the Aegean; to the west, Cape Tainaron separates this gulf from the waters of Messenia.
simp_chinese: 拉科尼亚湾深入伯罗奔尼撒半岛南部，夹在多岩的马尼半岛与马莱阿斯角之间。欧罗塔斯河在海湾尽头入海，肥沃的拉科尼亚平原在此与海岸相接。吉西翁位于海湾西北岸，两侧狭长的半岛则向南伸出，止于面向开阔海面的海角。绕过马莱阿斯角，水域通向爱琴海；西面的泰纳隆角则将这座海湾与麦西尼亚海域分开。

english:
Lal-lo lies on the eastern bank of the Cagayan River, a short distance upstream from its mouth. The river was the principal route through the valley, and the settlement became an early centre of Spanish authority in northern Luzon. It was renamed Nueva Segovia and made the seat of a diocese in 1595.

Dominican missionaries established churches in the town, including the church of Saint Dominic facing the river. Bishops buried there included Miguel de Benavides, later remembered as the founder of the University of Santo Tomas. Distance from Manila and the dangers posed by the river led to the transfer of the episcopal seat to Vigan in 1755. The older name Lal-lo continued in use after Nueva Segovia ceased to be the bishop's residence.
simp_chinese:
拉洛位于卡加延河东岸，距河口不远。河流是贯通河谷的主要通路，这座聚落成为西班牙人在吕宋北部的早期权力中心。它被改名为新塞哥维亚，1595年成为教区所在地。

多明我会传教士在城中建立教堂，包括面向河流的圣多明我教堂。埋葬于此的主教包括米格尔·德·贝纳维德斯，后人记得他创立了圣托马斯大学。由于距离马尼拉遥远，河流又带来危险，主教座于1755年迁往维甘。新塞哥维亚不再是主教驻地后，较古老的拉洛之名仍继续使用。

english: The Lalan flows through the wetlands of eastern Sumatra, north of the Musi basin. Old settlements in its river country left remains of houses on posts, pottery, beads and boat fittings, evidence of life among the waterways long before Srivijaya. A Jambi charter dated 1812 describes the Lalan as a boundary between lands associated with Jambi and Palembang. The river thus served both as a route through the lowlands and as a line by which neighbouring powers described their territories.
simp_chinese: 拉兰河流经苏门答腊东部湿地，在穆西河流域以北。沿河古聚落留下高脚建筑、陶器、珠饰和船具遗存，表明早在室利佛逝之前，人们已在水道之间生活。一份1812年的占碑文书将拉兰河描述为占碑与巨港所属土地的边界。河流既是穿越低地的通道，也是邻近政权界定领土的界线。

sources.title: UNDANG-UNDANG PIAGAM DAN KISAH NEGERI JAMBI.pdf

english: Lalek Cotaa is a name used by a Qom community in the plains of southern Santa Fe. The Qom, also known as Toba, speak a language of the Guaycuruan family and traditionally inhabited the Gran Chaco to the north. Their communities hunted, fished and gathered wild foods in a landscape of woodland, grassland and waterways. The Paraná and its tributaries link these plains to the larger river system of the Río de la Plata.
simp_chinese: 拉莱克科塔是圣菲南部平原一个科姆社群使用的名称。科姆人也称托巴人，使用瓜伊库鲁语族语言，传统上居住在北方的大查科。他们的社群在林地、草地和水道交错的地区狩猎、捕鱼并采集野生食物。巴拉那河及其支流将这些平原与拉普拉塔河更广大的水系相连。

english: Lalian lies in the Punjab plains between the Jhelum and Chenab rivers. It began as a village whose land was largely held by the Lali clan, with several branches of the clan living there. The village takes its place among the settlements of the Chaj Doab, the tract whose name joins those of the two rivers that enclose it.
simp_chinese: 拉利扬位于旁遮普平原，处在杰赫勒姆河与杰纳布河之间。这里最初是一座村落，土地大多为拉利氏族所有，氏族的几个支系都居住于此。村庄所在的遮杰河间地，名称取自环绕这片土地的两条河流。

english:
In the mountains of Lasta stands Lalibela, a holy place of Ethiopian Christianity renowned for its churches carved from living rock. Traditionally known as Roha, the town is associated with the Zagwe king Lalibela and the vision of a New Jerusalem. Eleven medieval churches, cut down into the stone and connected by trenches and passages, form an extraordinary place of worship and pilgrimage.

In the fifteenth century the town appeared as Lalabeda on Fra Mauro's map. The Portuguese priest Francisco Álvares visited twice during an embassy to Ethiopia in the 1520s and marveled at the churches, fearing that readers would scarcely believe his description. Plans of several churches accompanied a later printing of his account. During Ahmad al-Ghazi's invasion, the surrounding district was devastated in 1531, but the rock-hewn sanctuaries endured as a centre of prayer.
simp_chinese:
拉斯塔山区的拉利贝拉是埃塞俄比亚基督徒的圣地，以从整块岩石中凿出的教堂闻名。这里传统上称为罗哈，与扎格维王朝的拉利贝拉国王及其建立新耶路撒冷的理想相联系。十一座中世纪教堂向下凿入岩石，以沟道和通道相连，组成一处非凡的礼拜与朝圣之地。

十五世纪，弗拉·毛罗的地图以拉拉贝达之名标出了这座城镇。葡萄牙教士弗朗西斯科·阿尔瓦雷斯在1520年代随使团访问埃塞俄比亚时两次前来，惊叹于这些教堂，唯恐读者难以相信他的描述。后来印行的游记还附上了几座教堂的平面图。艾哈迈德·加齐入侵期间，周边地区在1531年遭到蹂躏，但岩凿圣所依然作为祈祷中心延续下来。

english: Lalín lies inland in the Galician district of Deza, amid a landscape dotted with ancient hillforts and burial mounds. The parish of San Martín de Lalín belonged to a countryside divided among many ecclesiastical and secular patrons. An eighteenth-century survey of the archpriesthood of Deza recorded neighboring parishes under the patronage of the crown, the bishop of Lugo, noble houses and monasteries. Their varied rights and revenues reveal the intricate pattern of authority in the district.
simp_chinese: 拉林位于加利西亚内陆的德萨地区，周围散布着古代山堡和墓丘。圣马丁德拉林堂区所在的乡间，由许多教会与世俗赞助者分掌权利。十八世纪对德萨总铎区的调查记载，附近堂区的任命权属于王室、卢戈主教、贵族家族和修道院等不同势力。各方的权利与收入，展现了这片地区错综交织的权力格局。

english: Laling's hill fort stood on the commercial road between Surat and Burhanpur and was an important stronghold of the Faruqi rulers of Khandesh. Malik Raja granted it to his eldest son, suggesting its prominence among his forts. In 1437 a Bahmani general besieged Nasir Khan and his son Miran Adil Khan at Laling, until an army from Gujarat came to their relief. Mughal troops later passed through the region on campaigns into the Deccan.
simp_chinese: 拉林山堡位于苏拉特与布尔汉普尔之间的商路上，是坎德什法鲁基统治者的重要据点。马利克·拉阇将它交给长子，可见此堡在其要塞中的地位。1437年，巴赫曼尼将领在拉林围困纳西尔汗和他的儿子米兰·阿迪勒汗，直到古吉拉特的援军赶来解围。后来莫卧儿军队向德干进军时也曾经过这一地区。

english: Lalitpur lies in the rocky, wooded country of Bundelkhand, between the Betwa and the hills of central India. Tradition credits Raja Sumer Singh with founding the town and naming it for his wife Lalita. To the west, the fortified hill of Deogarh overlooks the Betwa and preserves ancient Hindu and Jain temples. The surrounding territory later formed part of the Bundela state of Chanderi and came under Maratha influence in the eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 勒利德布尔位于本德尔坎德多岩石和林木的地区，地处贝特瓦河与印度中部丘陵之间。传统称苏梅尔·辛格王建立城镇，以妻子拉莉塔命名。西面的代奥格尔山堡俯瞰贝特瓦河，保存着古老的印度教和耆那教寺庙。周围领土后来属于本德拉人的钱德里邦，十八世纪受到马拉塔势力影响。

english: Lalpur lies in the eastern Afghan country of Nangarhar, home to the Mohmand Pashtuns. The family of the Khans of Lalpur held influence among the Mohmands, and traders passing through the area paid dues to its rulers. To the south, the Kabul River flows east from the Hindu Kush towards the Indus, carrying a name known in ancient times as Kubha.
simp_chinese: 拉尔布尔位于阿富汗东部的楠格哈尔地区，是莫曼德普什图人的家园。拉尔布尔汗的家族在莫曼德人中具有影响力，经过此地的商人向当地统治者缴纳税费。南面的喀布尔河从兴都库什山向东流向印度河，古代称作库巴河。

english: Lalsk takes its name from the Lala, a tributary of the Luza in the eastern Russian North. According to tradition, Novgorodians fleeing Ivan IV's massacre of their city founded the settlement. By the late seventeenth and eighteenth centuries it had become a substantial trading outpost. Its first stone church was consecrated in 1711, and in 1779 Lalsk received town status. The waterways around the settlement connected its merchants with the river systems of the northern interior.
simp_chinese: 拉利斯克因拉拉河得名，后者是俄罗斯北部东段卢扎河的一条支流。传说诺夫哥罗德人在伊凡四世屠戮其城市后向东逃亡，建立了这座聚落。十七世纪末至十八世纪，它发展为颇具规模的贸易前哨。第一座石教堂于1711年祝圣，1779年拉利斯克获得城镇地位。周围水道将当地商人与北方内陆的河流网络联系起来。

english: Lamakera stands at the eastern end of Solor, looking across the strait toward Lembata. Its sailors are known for hunting at sea from small boats, using harpoons of different sizes for turtles, rays and larger prey. The community belonged to the island world of Solor Watan Lema, an alliance of coastal settlements whose remembered relationships reached east toward Alor. Its position at the strait placed the village among the linked communities of the Solor archipelago.
simp_chinese: 拉马克拉位于索洛尔岛东端，隔海峡与勒姆巴塔相望。当地航海者以乘小舟出海捕猎闻名，使用大小不同的鱼叉捕取海龟、鳐鱼和更大的猎物。这里属于索洛尔瓦丹勒马的岛屿世界，这一沿海聚落联盟所记得的关系向东延伸到阿罗尔。村庄扼守海峡，处在索洛尔群岛相互联系的社群之间。

english: Lamalama country lies on the eastern side of Cape York Peninsula around Princess Charlotte Bay. Several Aboriginal languages are associated with the Lamalama peoples, including Umpithamu. Along the bay, coastal communities maintained connections to sandy shores and the waters beyond them, while neighbouring groups occupied country farther inland.
simp_chinese: 拉马拉马人的土地位于约克角半岛东侧的夏洛特公主湾一带。多种原住民语言与拉马拉马诸族有关，其中包括翁皮塔穆语。沿湾的海岸社群与沙岸及外海水域保持联系，邻近人群则居住在更远的内陆。
